data.jd_text:
Project London is looking for a Senior Architect to join our Dubai studio as we continue to grow our presence in the UAE.
 



  





 You must be based in Dubai
 



  





 We are a London founded architecture, interiors and project management studio, now bringing the same level of process, detail, commercial rigour and client care to Dubai. Our work is primarily high end private residential, including villas, apartments, bespoke new builds, refurbishments and full interior led transformations.
 



 This is a senior role for someone who can combine strong design judgement with technical competence, site confidence and the ability to manage projects properly from concept through to completion. We are looking for someone who understands that good architecture is not just about beautiful images. It is about clear thinking, proper coordination, robust detailing, buildability, budget awareness and protecting the client’s interests throughout.
 



  





 The Role
 



 The Senior Architect will take responsibility for leading architectural design and technical delivery across a range of private residential projects in Dubai. You will work closely with the Director in Dubai, as well as our interiors, project management and procurement teams, external consultants, contractors, suppliers and client teams.
 



 You will be expected to manage projects with confidence, communicate clearly and bring order to complex design and construction processes. The right person will be comfortable working both in the studio and on site, and will have the experience to spot issues before they become problems.
 



 As Project London UAE grows, this role will offer genuine involvement in shaping how the studio operates, how projects are delivered and how we set standards in the Dubai market.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Lead architectural design packages from early concept through to detailed design and construction information.
 



 Prepare and oversee drawings, specifications, schedules and technical documentation.
 



 Develop layouts, spatial planning, elevations, sections, details and coordinated design packages.
 



 Coordinate with interior designers, MEP consultants, structural engineers, landscape designers, contractors and suppliers.
 



 Review consultant and contractor information to ensure quality, accuracy and alignment with the design intent.
 



 Support authority and developer approval processes, including Emaar, Dubai Municipality, Trakhees and relevant community or master developer requirements.
 



 Attend site meetings and carry out site inspections to review workmanship, progress and compliance with the drawings.
 



 Identify design, technical and coordination risks early and propose practical solutions.
 



 Assist with tender documentation, contractor queries and technical clarifications.
 



 Support project managers with programme, sequencing, cost control and client reporting.
 



 Maintain high standards of drawing presentation, technical accuracy and file organisation.
 



 Represent Project London professionally with clients, consultants and contractors.
 



  





 Requirements
 



 Degree in Architecture or equivalent professional qualification.
 



 Minimum 8 to 10 years’ professional experience, ideally with at least some UAE or GCC project experience.
 



 Strong experience in high end residential architecture.
 



 Excellent technical detailing and construction knowledge.
 



 Confident working across concept design, technical design, tender and construction stages.
 



 Good understanding of Dubai authority, developer and community approval processes.
 



 Strong AutoCAD skills are essential.
 



 Confident on site and comfortable challenging contractors when required.
 



 Strong coordination skills across architecture, interiors, MEP, structure and specialist suppliers.
 



 Excellent written and spoken English.
 



 Highly organised, proactive and commercially aware.
 



 Able to manage multiple workstreams without losing sight of detail.
 



 A calm, professional manner with clients and project teams.
 



  





 The Person
 



 We are looking for someone who takes pride in doing things properly. Someone who can bring design sensitivity, technical rigour and a steady hand to fast moving projects.
 



 You should be comfortable working in a growing studio environment, where everyone contributes and where standards matter. This is not a role for someone who wants to hide behind drawings. We need someone who can think, communicate, coordinate and take responsibility.
 



 You will suit the role if you are:
 



 Practical as well as creative.
 



 Detail focused without losing sight of the bigger picture.
 



 Comfortable with clients, consultants and contractors.
 



 Able to bring calm and clarity to complex situations.
 



 Interested in raising standards in the Dubai residential market.
 



  





 Why Join Project London
 



 This is an exciting opportunity to join Project London UAE at an early stage of its growth, while being backed by an established London studio with a strong reputation in high end residential architecture, interiors and project delivery.
 



 You will work closely with the Director in Dubai and have real involvement in the development of the studio, the way projects are delivered, and the standards we set as we grow. This is not a role where you will disappear into a large corporate structure. You will be close to the decision making, close to the clients and close to the work itself.
 



 We are building something carefully in Dubai, not chasing volume for the sake of it. The aim is to deliver exceptional private residential projects with the same rigour, attention to detail and client care our London clients expect.
 



 For the right person, this is a chance to help shape a growing studio, contribute meaningfully from day one and be part of a business with genuine ambition in the UAE market.
 



  





 Package
 



 Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
 



 Full time role based in Dubai.
 



 Immediate or early start preferred.
 



  





 How to Apply
 



 Please send your CV, portfolio and answers to the questions below to:
 



 sm@projectlondon.co.uk
 



 Subject line
 



 Senior Architect Application, Dubai
 



 We would particularly like to see examples of residential projects where you have been involved in technical design, coordination and site delivery, not just concept imagery.
 



  





 Application Questions
 



 Please answer the following four questions when applying. 
 **Anyone who does not answer all four questions will not be considered.** 



1. **Please summarise your relevant experience and explain why you believe you would be a strong fit for this Senior Architect role at Project London UAE. Please include the types of projects you have worked on, your level of responsibility and what you would bring to the team.**
2. **Please describe one completed residential project where you were responsible for taking the design from concept through to technical detailing, tender or site delivery. What was your role, what were the main challenges and what did you personally resolve?**
3. **In Dubai, residential projects often involve tight coordination between architecture, interiors, MEP, structure, authority approvals, contractors and suppliers. Please give an example of where you identified a coordination issue before it became a site problem. How did you handle it?**
4. **Please attach or link to one drawing package, detail sheet or technical example that best represents your own work. Briefly explain what you personally produced and why it demonstrates your suitability for this role.**

**Job Description**
**What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?**
 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

 WSP is seeking to appoint a Head of Architecture Integration \& Building Performance, a role that provides a single point of portfolio\-level direction and leadership across Fire \& Life Safety, Building Enclosures / Facades, and Technical Architecture, with clear line management accountability for the Heads of these disciplines.
   

  

 The Heads of Discipline already deliver strongly and cover many of the technical and operational activities within their teams. This role is not created to duplicate that work. It is created to formalize the portfolio\-level direction and alignment that has historically been driven by the Director of Specialists, ensuring consistent prioritization, governance, and follow\-through across the three business lines.
   

  

 The role will drive disciplined implementation of the Specialist Services Strategy and the Global Specialist Strategy for this portfolio, with particular emphasis on accelerating growth in Technical Architecture (architecture\-led technical coordination and expanded scope), while proactively managing delivery risk where FLS and building enclosures performance can impact project outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Portfolio leadership \& direction (non\-negotiable)**
* Set one clear direction across the portfolio: priorities, standards, decision\-making, and escalation routes.
* Align discipline plans so delivery and growth efforts are coordinated and outcome\-driven.
* Lead delivery recovery when projects are off track due to late inputs, rework, inconsistent advice, or weak coordination, with particular focus on high\-risk interfaces (e.g., Envelope ↔ Architecture/Structure/MEP/FLS dependencies).


**Line management of Heads of Discipline**
* Line\-manage the Heads of FLS, Building Enclosures/Facades, and Technical Architecture with accountability for performance, delivery discipline, team health, and capability building.
* Coach and enable the Heads of Discipline on complex delivery issues, client risk, resourcing constraints, and cross\-discipline coordination.
* Drive an operating rhythm that reduces reliance on the Director of Specialists for day\-to\-day direction.


**Technical authority \& delivery governance (quality \+ consistency)**
* Act as a credible technical authority (in at least one of the three disciplines) with the ability to challenge and guide across the portfolio.
* Define “what good looks like” for deliverables (minimum content, evidence requirements, review expectations) and ensure consistent application across the portfolio.
* Implement and enforce governance so issues do not repeat: standards, peer reviews, readiness gates, decision logs, and action\-closure discipline.


**Operational Excellence (ways of working that stick)**
* Establish consistent delivery ways of working across the portfolio (review gates, interfaces, escalation routes) and drive adoption.
* Drive measurable improvement in right\-first\-time outputs, fewer late changes, and clearer accountability across the three disciplines.


**Strategy adherence \& implementation (Specialist Services Strategy 2025–2027\)**
* Own implementation across the four pillars for this portfolio: Clients, Expertise, Operational Excellence, People \& Culture.
* Ensure discipline pillar champions/leads are active and contributing as designed, and translate strategy into practical execution and consistent follow\-through.
* Remove blockers so progress is sustained and not dependent on ad hoc senior intervention.


**Go\-to\-market and growth leadership (per business line)**
* Drive growth of each business line through market positioning, bid quality, cross\-sell, and consistent go\-to\-market collateral aligned to the Global Specialist Strategy intent.
* For Technical Architecture, accelerate growth by expanding scope and strengthening architecture\-led technical coordination and design integration aligned to the team’s published strategy direction.
* Contribute to global alignment outputs relevant to this portfolio (e.g., discipline forums / collaboration inputs and go\-to\-market strategy contributions) as required.


**People leadership \& capability building (portfolio bench strength)**
* Build bench strength across the portfolio (deputies, succession, coaching) and embed capability uplift through People \& Culture and Expertise pillars.
* Identify targeted upskilling and recruitment priorities aligned to strategy and growth needs.


**Qualifications**
* 20\+ years’ experience with senior leadership exposure in complex building environments, with strong relevance to Architecture / Technical Architecture and the ability to lead across Building Safety and Envelope disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to lead senior discipline heads and drive consistent standards and outcomes across multiple specialisms.
* Track record of implementing operating models and standards (not just writing strategy).
* Strong stakeholder influence across disciplines and regions.


**Essential Behaviours**
* Delivery spine: drives closure, makes decisions stick, holds standards under pressure.
* Strategic thinking with practical execution: converts intent into clear prioritisation and outcomes.
* Collaborative “one team” mindset aligned to global specialist connectivity and growth objectives.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

**Regional Commissiong Manager**
**Location\- Saudi Arabia**
**Summary**
 To manage the regional Cx Team and in certain instances Lead / Supervise the entire commissioning process on specific sites including all commissioning contractual deliverables and JEG QSP documentation. Coordinate with all departments to ensure a smooth handover from construction through to commissioning and client handover, including extensive follow\-up with contractors, vendors and the client site team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Direct line of report \- Operational – Operations Director / Site Specific – Project Director


**Functional Duties**
* Review the active / tender projects portfolio scope of works and identify the correct structure and team required to deliver the projects and incorporate them into the overall Projects Organograms.
* Ensure that all Cx team staff levels are adequate, manage recruitment and function overhead as required to ensure the Cx Team manpower is always at optimum levels and skilled as required
* Identify skill deficiencies in Cx team members and manage training development plans to ensure all team members are upskilled and certified as applicable for assigned tasks.
* Manage and coordinate with project specific site Cx Teams to ensure all sites are utilizing standard JEG reporting documentation and complying with JEG company SOP’s / site and client specific documentation to be utilized as required.
* Ensure all items / actions as defined below in “Specific Site Duties” are actioned via the assigned Cx Leads and associated teams if not directly assigned to manage directly.
* Commercial input regarding Cx budgets set for projects and functional operations as directed.
* Review and coordination with QA/QC Leads and ensure QA/QC requirements are identified for implementation
* In coordination with site MEP Leads ensure correct codes, standards, job specifications, project procedures, local mandatory regulations are properly identified, correctly specified in detail, and met or exceeded
* Ensure Electrical and Mechanical installation teams maintain standards in accordance with the approved Method Statements, Technical Orders/Manuals and ISO Standards as applicable.
* Close coordination and oversight with Divisional Authorizing Engineer and site SAP’s / AP’s as applicable.
* Assist with ensuring that the quality management system (QMS) is fully implemented in an organized and efficient manner whilst working closely with related engineering, construction, fabrication and commissioning departments.
* Provide support as requested for Method Statement preparation and client presentations as required.
* Prepare overall Project Executive Summary Reports and attend weekly meetings as required for progress updates on projects
* Escalate to Line Manager any issues arising that may affect project schedule or project execution plans.
* Advancing quality achievement and performance improvement throughout the project
* Coordination with ALL vendors for documentation (RAMS, ITP’s, Red Line Drawings, L2 \& L3 Start Up Scripts, SAT)
* Plan Mobilization Dates and Resources for 3rd Party vendors and Commissioning Contractors in coordination with the Project Controls Lead.
* Plan and Manage the Testing \& Balancing Team activities.
* Assist Design Team in developing the Equipment Tagging Register for Equipment Labelling (Traffolyte / SS)
* Coordination of vendors/engineering for all inter connections between packages (HW \& SW)
* Liaise with the QA/QC Inspectors for progress updates during the installation process.
* Liaise closely with the ELV Lead for BMS readiness, per package as per the commissioning program.
* Manage the QA/QC snagging list and ensure follow up of closures with the Construction Managers, not to delay the commissioning schedule.
* Prepare and distribute a Commissioning Issues Log independently to the Internal MEP snag list during the Commissioning Phase. (FAT à L2 à L3 à SAT à IST)
* Manage closely the static testing of MV \& LV power cabling, ensuring the installation adheres to approved drawings. Any “To/From” deviations to be escalated immediately.
* Prepare and issue a weekly Commissioning Dashboard report in coordination with the Project Controls Lead.
* Prepare and issue a 2\-week static and pre\-functional testing look ahead program in coordination with the Project Controls Lead \- To be updated and issued on a weekly basis.


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Time served apprenticeship an advantage.
* Electrical, Mechanical, Instrumentation Engineer
* Minimum 15 years work experience on construction projects.
* Qualifications commensurate with position:
* Role applicable degree from a reputed university / Trade Qualifications NVQ, etc.
* Experience in Data Centre Projects min 5 years.
* Equipment category specific training
* LOTO Experience Responsible Person (REP)
* Competent in the use of PC applications (Microsoft Office suit or equivalent).

Job description:
   

  

 Purpose of the Job
 
 This pivotal role leads the global development and management of Aramex's project cargo services, encompassing diverse transportation modes such as air and sea charters, breakbulk, heavy lift, and out\-of\-gauge shipments. The position drives business growth by creating innovative logistics solutions tailored to complex industrial projects worldwide.
 



 The Global Industrial Project Commercial Director collaborates closely with regional teams, clients, and carriers, ensuring seamless execution of logistics operations that meet profitability targets, comply with international regulations, and deliver exceptional service excellence.
 


 Job Description
 
**Commercial Leadership and Strategic Growth** 




 Design and implement comprehensive project cargo growth strategies worldwide, focusing on high\-impact industries including energy, oil \& gas, infrastructure, mining, and industrial manufacturing. Lead efforts to secure major contracts by managing client pipelines and collaborating on complex tenders, pricing frameworks, and vendor relationships. Cultivate enduring partnerships with key clients, EPC contractors, and strategic stakeholders to expand market presence.
 



**Project Cargo Operations Leadership** 




 Oversee the end\-to\-end coordination of project cargo shipments, ensuring safe, timely, and cost\-efficient deliveries that meet stringent quality standards. Manage multimodal logistics operations, including charters, breakbulk shipments, heavy\-lift vessels, and specialized transport equipment. Collaborate cross\-functionally with global operations, carriers, and service providers to identify and resolve operational risks and challenges proactively.
 



**Subject\-Matter Expertise and Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 Serve as the authoritative expert on project logistics and heavy\-lift cargo movements, providing guidance and support to regional teams to enhance project acquisition and execution capabilities. Foster integrated solutions by bridging air, ocean, and land transport teams, facilitating knowledge exchange, and championing innovation in logistics processes.
 



**Financial Stewardship and Performance Management** 




 Develop robust pricing models for charter and project cargo services that balance competitiveness with profitability. Take ownership of financial outcomes, rigorously monitoring cost control, forecasting, and performance metrics. Deliver comprehensive reports on revenue, margins, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction trends to senior leadership, driving informed decision\-making.
 



**Risk Management, Compliance, and Governance** 




 Identify operational and commercial risks associated with oversized and multimodal cargo shipments. Ensure strict adherence to international shipping laws, safety protocols, and trade regulations to safeguard organizational compliance and reputation. Lead initiatives to maintain the highest standards of operational integrity across all project cargo activities.
 



**Capability Building and Market Expansion** 




 Enhance project cargo expertise through targeted training programs, mentoring, and sharing best practices across the global network. Support pipeline development in emerging markets and industries by leveraging insights into evolving logistics trends and customer needs. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen Aramex’s competitive position globally.
 


 Job Requirements \- Experience and Education
 * Candidates should possess 15 to 20 years of distinguished experience managing and growing project cargo operations across multiple regions including GCC, MENAT, China, Africa, South Asia, and the United States. Proven success in leading large\-scale logistics projects, negotiating significant contracts, and directing multidisciplinary teams is essential.
* A strong academic foundation in logistics, supply chain management, engineering, or related disciplines is desirable, paired with demonstrated leadership capabilities within a global industrial logistics context.
* Expertise in air and sea charter operations, heavy lift handling, and multimodal transportation logistics is critical. The ideal professional will have a strategic outlook focused on commercial growth, operational excellence, risk mitigation, and regulatory compliance.

**Job Description**
**Position Overview**
 The Senior Project Manager (Tech) will support the Technical Team Lead in overseeing internal AI and software development projects, as well as client\-facing technical solutions. The role will focus on end\-to\-end project delivery, including planning, execution, monitoring, and closure, with an emphasis on agile methodologies. This position requires strong organizational skills, technical background in software development, and the ability to manage cross\-functional teams effectively.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to delivery, ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with objectives.
* Support resource planning, workload allocation, and timeline estimation for multiple concurrent projects.
* Track progress, risks, and dependencies across cross\-functional teams and ensure timely reporting to the Technical Team Lead.
* Apply agile methodologies to manage sprint cycles, prioritize deliverables, and accommodate ad\-hoc requests during project execution.
* Coordinate integration efforts and R\&D\-driven development for both internal and client\-facing solutions.
* Identify and propose process improvements to enhance efficiency and delivery quality.
* Create, contribute to, and maintain department Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other technical documentation.
* Maintain accurate project documentation and reporting using ClickUp.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in project management, with a focus on full\-stack software development.
* Proven experience managing cross\-functional teams in agile environments.
* Strong knowledge of project management tools, specifically ClickUp, or alternatively JIRA and Confluence.
* Familiarity with AI/ML projects is a plus.
* Exceptional organizational, problem\-solving, and communication skills.


**Key Competencies**
* Adaptability and agility in dynamic environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and reporting skills.
* Crisis\-handling ability under tight deadlines.
* Experience working in cross\-cultural, distributed teams.


**Careers at APCO**
 Through our recruitment, hiring and retention efforts, APCO is committed to building teams to bring the best possible expertise and robust perspectives to our clients. We embrace differences in experience, viewpoint and ideas, starting with our values and extending to our behaviors, policies and practices. We aim to create a positive work experience and welcoming environment where everyone feels they belong and can thrive.

**Summary** 




  





 This role is responsible for the quantity surveying functions across development
 



 projects, ensuring alignment with budget, timelines, and company policies. The
 



 Senior Quantity Surveyor manage cost planning, review external cost consultants,
 



 and provide strategic insights to senior leadership

1. Review, check, and provide guidance on all matters related to Procurement and Commercial Management, both pre and post contract administration.

3. Ensure that procurement activities align with the overall Development program.
4. Prepare Requests for Proposals/Requests for Price, gather relevant information from internal stakeholders, manage the procurement process, and review tender submissions to recommend and award contracts.

9. Keep the Line Manager and Senior Director – Commercial informed of ongoing activities, developments, and issues, and seek advice or guidance on matters impacting the project.
10. Review and plan responses to exceptional issues within assigned areas of responsibility.

**Competencies**

data.jd_text:
**Who We Are**
 Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry\-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.
   

  

 WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com
   

  

 For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
   

  

**More About The Role**
 Burson’s MENA operations stand as one of the largest and most respected communications agencies in the region, delivering impactful strategies rooted in craft, curiosity, counsel, and camaraderie. Burson MENA is a trusted partner for clients navigating complex communications and public affairs landscapes, shaping reputations, and driving business outcomes across diverse sectors.
   

  

 Burson MENA has offices in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Saudi Arabia and also part of the region is Qatar, Jordan, Bahrain and Egypt. Our team combines strategic expertise with AI\-driven insights to craft compelling narratives that influence key decision\-makers. Backed by a strong international and global network, we provide innovative, data\-driven solutions that connect with audiences and create lasting impact. At Burson, our inclusive and high\-performance culture fuels innovation, empowering individuals to excel and collaborate in a dynamic environment where growth thrives.
   

  

 We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Dubai\-based Account Director to join our Destination Marketing practice. This pivotal role will focus on our portfolio of B2B/Corporate real estate clients, as well as broader destination projects. You will be instrumental in leading strategic communication initiatives, fostering deep client relationships, and driving impactful campaigns. This role offers the opportunity to lead and innovate within a fast\-paced environment, working with high\-profile clients and collaborating with industry\-leading experts. You will leverage your expertise in corporate \& consumer communications, B2B/corporate media relations, and your robust experience in destination or real estate communications.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead and manage key client accounts within the Destination Marketing practice, with a specific focus on B2B/Corporate real estate clients.
* Develop and execute sophisticated communication strategies that integrate corporate \& consumer communications for maximum impact.
* Drive B2B/corporate media relations, building and maintaining strong relationships with key business, real estate, and trade journalists and influencers.
* Oversee comprehensive press office functions, proactively identifying news angles and expertly managing reactive media enquiries for corporate and real estate clients.
* Provide high\-level strategic counsel to clients, guiding them through complex communication challenges and market opportunities.
* Lead the development of high\-quality content, including strategic presentations, thought leadership pieces, press releases, and digital narratives tailored for B2B audiences.
* Mentor and manage junior team members, fostering their development and ensuring excellence in project execution.


**Experience That Contributes To Success**
* Bi\-lingual Arabic \& English highly desirable
* Proven experience as an Account Director (or equivalent senior role) in a communications agency or in\-house team, with significant exposure to B2B/Corporate real estate clients.
* Demonstrable expertise in both corporate \& consumer communications, with a strategic understanding of how to bridge the two.
* Exceptional track record in B2B/corporate media relations, with established contacts and a deep understanding of the real estate and business media landscape.
* Extensive experience within destination marketing or real estate communications is essential.
* A strategic thinker with a proven ability to develop and execute complex, integrated communication plans that achieve measurable business objectives.
* An adept client handler, capable of building trusted advisor relationships and confidently sharing strategic counsel at a senior level.


**You Belong At Burson**
 Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.
   

  

 At Burson, we’re an agency of learn\-it\-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a \#BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

 When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our  California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

**Company Description** 




 Golden Square Engineering Consultants (GS), founded in 2001, is a multi\-disciplinary planning and design firm dedicated to delivering innovative and sustainable solutions. With a strong presence in the UAE and MENA region, the firm offers a full range of architectural and engineering services for public and private sector projects, including industrial, residential, commercial, and institutional developments. Committed to high\-quality, energy\-efficient, and sustainable design, GS collaborates with major developers, contractors, and consultants to ensure on\-time and budget\-conscious project completion. Operating from offices in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Sharjah, Baghdad, and Canada, GS has designed numerous landmark projects, earning a reputation for excellence and integrity in the industry.

**The Technical Director is the highest technical authority within the organization, responsible for leading multidisciplinary design and construction supervision functions across a diverse portfolio of projects. This role ensures technical excellence, regulatory compliance, and alignment between design intent and project execution throughout the full project lifecycle.**

**dentify and mitigate technical risks and implement corrective actions.**

**Support business development through technical input in proposals and presentations.**

**Lead technical negotiations and resolve complex project issues.** 




  





**4\.        Team Leadership \& Development** 




**Lead, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary technical teams.** 




**Oversee recruitment, performance management, and succession planning.** 




**Promote knowledge sharing and technical excellence across departments.** 




  





**5\.        Financial \& Operational Oversight** 




**Contribute to business strategy and operational planning.**

**Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance monitoring.** 




**Ensure efficient utilization of technical resources across projects.** 




  





**6\.        Compliance and Quality**

data.jd_text:
The Head of Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering function as a core competitive advantage for the System Integration Division. The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. The role also builds organizational capability by developing high\-performing engineering teams, strengthening supplier and OEM partnerships, and supporting bids, new solutions, and product development initiatives.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
****Job Responsibilities****
****Job Requirements****
**Engineering Strategy \& Technical Authority**
* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.
* Define and execute the technology roadmap including adoption of modern substation automation, IEC 61850 architectures, smart MCCs, and digitalization initiatives.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for major technical failures, NCRs, or quality concerns.


* Project Engineering \& Bid Management
* Provide technical leadership during bids, tenders, and proposal stage, ensuring optimal technical and commercial positioning.
* Validate technical compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee project engineering to ensure designs are delivered on time, within budget, and with zero major deviations.
* Manage interfaces with clients, consultants, OEMs (Siemens, ABB, GE, SEL, Schneider, etc.), and internal stakeholders.
* Balance standardization vs. customization to improve efficiency without compromising project requirements.
* Support business growth by enabling engineering capability for new markets, products, and solutions.
* Ensure seamless coordination with Testing \& Commissioning teams for successful system validation and handover.
* Departmental Leadership \& Capability Building
* Establish and lead a high\-performing engineering organization including Protection, Automation, Design, and Application Engineering.
* Define competency frameworks, skill matrix, and succession pipeline for critical roles.
* Drive recruitment, mentoring, and technical capability development.
* Optimize engineering resource planning across multiple concurrent projects.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Commercial \& Value Engineering
* Own engineering cost optimization through value engineering and design efficiency.
* Review and influence project profitability through technical decisions.
* Identify cost drivers within BOMs and propose alternatives without compromising performance.
* 
+ Support contract negotiations on technical clauses and deviations.

* Quality, Safety \& Compliance (Non\-Negotiables)
+ Ensure all engineering outputs comply with international standards including:
+ IEC 60255
+ IEC 61850
+ IEC 61131
+ IEC 61439
+ IEEE C37
+ ISO 9001
+ Integrate Safety by Design principles including arc\-flash mitigation, segregation, and isolation philosophy.
+ Ensure robust documentation control, ISO compliance, and accuracy of as\-built drawings and O\&M manuals.
+ Maintain centralized engineering data repository and knowledge management systems.


**Qualifications**
**Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (Master’s preferred).** 
****Experience****
* 15–18\+ years of relevant experience in Protection, Automation, Panel, or System Integration Engineering.
* Minimum 5–8 years in a senior engineering leadership or departmental head role.
* Experience handling multi\-million AED EPC or system integration projects is preferred


**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise** 
  

  

* Protection Engineering
+ Deep expertise in protection schemes (Differential, Distance, REF, Overcurrent, Busbar).
+ Relay coordination , system studies, and CT/VT sizing.

* Panel \& System Design
+ LV/MV panel design, heat dissipation, segregation, earthing, and wiring philosophy.

* Automation \& Communication
+ SCADA, RTU, IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870\-5 protocols.

* Engineering Tools
+ EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical
+ DIGSI, AcSELerator, EnerVista
+ ETAP / SKM

* Commercial Acumen
+ Strong understanding of technical specifications, BOM costing, value engineering, and project lifecycle

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 Purpose of the Role
   

  

 The Head of Primary is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic oversight, management, and continuous improvement of the primary school. This role ensures the delivery of high\-quality, inclusive education, promotes whole\-child development, and contributes to school\-wide strategic planning.
   

  

 The postholder will lead academic and pastoral priorities, oversee curriculum and assessment, drive professional development, and monitor teaching and learning outcomes. The role is aligned with UK Teachers’ Standards, KHDA Framework, and the School Improvement Plan (SIP), ensuring excellence across teaching, leadership, inclusion, and student achievement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic Leadership and Management
   

  

* Lead the primary phase in line with school\-wide SIP objectives and SEF priorities, contributing to whole\-school strategy.
* Develop, implement, and evaluate phase\-wide action plans, ensuring alignment with KHDA SEF criteria and school improvement goals.
* Monitor student progress, teaching quality, and departmental performance, using data to inform targeted interventions and continuous improvement.
* Lead, mentor, and appraise all primary staff, fostering professional growth, collaboration, and high morale.
* Manage resources, budgets, and facilities to optimise learning opportunities across the phase.


 Teaching and Learning Oversight
   

  

* Ensure high\-quality, engaging, and inclusive teaching across the primary phase.
* Promote cross\-curricular literacy, numeracy, STEM, and creative skills, embedding UAE heritage and values.
* Develop innovative, evidence\-based teaching approaches and ensure effective differentiation for all learners, including ELL students and Students of Determination.
* Lead curriculum planning and development in line with UK curriculum expectations, MoE requirements, and international best practice.


 Assessment, Monitoring, and Reporting
   

  

* Analyse data to monitor progress, attainment, and trends across the primary phase.
* Ensure robust assessment, tracking, and reporting systems are in place and inform SEF evaluations.
* Provide strategic recommendations to SLT to enhance student achievement and wellbeing.


 Pastoral and Safeguarding Leadership
   

  

* Promote a safe, nurturing, and inclusive learning environment.
* Ensure proactive safeguarding, pastoral care, and support for Students of Determination.
* Champion student wellbeing, resilience, and personal development.


 Collaboration and Community Engagement
   

  

* Act as a key representative of the primary phase within SLT and the wider school community.
* Build strong partnerships with parents, the community, and external agencies to enhance student learning and wellbeing.
* Lead primary phase participation in school\-wide initiatives, enrichment, and extracurricular programs.


**Essential**
 Skills, Qualifications, and Experience
   

  

* Qualified teacher with extensive primary leadership experience
* Minimum 5–7 years teaching experience with at least 3 years in leadership or middle/senior management
* Deep understanding of curriculum design, assessment, differentiation, and inclusion
* Proven experience in strategic planning, staff mentoring, and managing performance
* Strong knowledge of safeguarding, pastoral care, and wellbeing


**Desirable**
* Experience in UAE or international schools
* Familiarity with KHDA inspections, SEF, SIP, and MoE curriculum for primary


 Competencies and Attributes
   

  

* Strategic, visionary, and collaborative senior leader
* Empathetic, culturally aware, and approachable
* Innovative, proactive, and solution\-focused
* Strong organisational, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills
* Committed to excellence in teaching, learning, inclusion, and wellbeing
* Integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism


 Alignment to Standards
   

  

**UK Teachers’ Standards (Leadership Focus)**
* Set and maintain high expectations for students and staff
* Ensure effective teaching and learning strategies across the primary phase
* Manage behaviour, pastoral care, and professional responsibilities effectively
* Lead continuous professional development and mentoring


**KHDA SEF \& Education Inspection Framework**
* Student Achievement and Progress – strategic oversight and intervention planning
* Teaching for Effective Learning – ensure consistent, high\-quality pedagogy
* Personal Development, Behaviour, and Wellbeing – support confidence, independence, and resilience
* Provision for Students of Determination – inclusive practices and differentiated support
* Leadership, Collaboration, and Professional Responsibilities – contribute to SEF self\-evaluation, SIP targets, and whole\-school improvement


**School Improvement Plan (SIP) Alignment**
* Drive whole\-school priorities and measurable outcomes for the primary phase
* Lead initiatives to raise attainment, close gaps, and enhance teaching quality
* Ensure departmental and phase actions support school\-wide strategic goals


**UAE Ministry Of Education Alignment**
* Deliver lessons according to MoE curriculum standards for primary
* Embed UAE heritage, culture, and values within the curriculum
* Champion inclusion and development of Students of Determination


**ISP Principles**
**Begin with our children and students** 
 . Our children and students are at the heart of what we do. Simply, their success is our success. Wellbeing and safety are both essential for learners and learning. Therefore, we are consistent in identifying potential safeguarding
   

  

 and Health \& Safety issues and acting and following up on all concerns appropriately.
   

  

**Treat everyone with care and respect** 
 . We look after one another, embrace similarities and differences and promote the well\-being of self and others.
   

  

**Operate effectively.** 
 We focus relentlessly on the things that are most important and will make the most difference. We apply school policies and procedures and embody the shared ideas of our community.
   

  

**Are financially responsible.** 
 We make financial choices carefully based on the needs of the children, students and our schools.
   

  

**Learn continuously.** 
 Getting better is what drives us. We positively engage with personal and professional development and school improvement.
   

  

**ISP Commitment to Safeguarding Principles**
 ISP is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to appropriate vetting procedures, including an online due diligence search, references and satisfactory Criminal Background Checks or equivalent covering the previous 10 years’ employment history.
   

  

**ISP Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 ISP is committed to strengthening our inclusive culture by identifying, hiring, developing, and retaining high\-performing teammates regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation and gender expression, age, disability status, neurodivergence, socio\-economic background or other demographic characteristics. Candidates who share our vision and principles and are interested in contributing to the success of ISP through this role are strongly encouraged to apply.

data.jd_text:
**About Keyrock**
 Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change\-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
   

  

 Today, we rock with over 180 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels and Singapore, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
   

  

 We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well\-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high\-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.
   

  

 But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
   

  

 At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
   

  

**Mission statement**
 The
 **Tech Lead** 
 plays a pivotal role in bridging
 **business objectives** 
 with
 **technical execution** 
 . This role is not purely managerial nor solely individual contributor, but a
 **hybrid position** 
 that combines
 **hands\-on engineering** 
 ,
 **architectural leadership** 
 , and
 **team enablement** 
 . A Tech Lead ensures delivery excellence by actively contributing to the codebase, guiding the team technically, and aligning execution with long\-term strategic goals.
   

  

 At Keyrock, the
 **Tech Lead** 
 is a
 **senior technical contributor** 
 who drives the
 **implementation and delivery** 
 of engineering initiatives within their Business Unit. The Tech Lead is accountable for
 **technical execution and delivery quality** 
 , ensuring that systems are built to high standards of reliability, performance, and maintainability.
   

  

 While the
 **Head of Engineering (HoE)** 
 focuses on
 **strategic alignment \-** 
 ensuring that engineering outcomes meet the broader objectives agreed with the
 **Head of Product (HoP) \-** 
 the Tech Lead operates as the
 **executional deputy** 
 , translating those strategic objectives into code, architecture, and delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Act as the technical point of accountability for the Service Market Making Business Unit.
* Balance strategic thinking with pragmatic delivery, ensuring systems are built to last while meeting immediate needs.
* Champion collaboration across teams, ensuring alignment between product, design, QA, and engineering.
* Inspire and develop engineers through mentorship, coaching, and technical guidance, fostering growth and autonomy within the team.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Drive Delivery and Alignment: Partner with the Head of Engineering to own delivery of entire work\-streams, ensuring architecture and engineering decisions align with both immediate requirements and business strategy.
* Balance Code and Leadership: Contribute directly through coding, while also focusing on architecture design, peer reviews, and cross\-functional communication.
* Mentor and Elevate Engineers: Provide structured feedback through design and code reviews, support skill development, and empower junior and mid\-level engineers to take ownership.
* Technical Leadership: Guide system design, ensure scalability and resilience, and optimise performance across applications and infrastructure.
* Maintain Standards: Uphold engineering best practices, enforce coding guidelines, and partner with QA to embed automation and validation in the delivery pipeline.
* Codebase Health: Manage technical debt, lead refactoring initiatives, and ensure long\-term maintainability and operational excellence.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to define scope, refine requirements, and plan delivery in a transparent and predictable manner.
* Risk Management: Anticipate technical risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs early, and propose mitigations to safeguard delivery timelines.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years in a Technical Leadership position guiding teams, shaping architecture, and driving delivery of complex projects
* Demonstrated expertise in architecting and maintaining high\-concurrency, low\-latency trading systems at scale
* Advanced proficiency in Rust; working knowledge of Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript) and Python is an advantage
* Deep experience with data\-intensive architectures and real\-time data pipelines
* Proven track record deploying, optimising and operating AWS environments for ultra\-low\-latency workloads
* Hands\-on experience containerising applications and managing Kubernetes clusters in production
* Familiarity with GitOps workflows to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration and deployments
* Solid command of software engineering best practices, including Agile methodologies, DevOps principles and end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines
* Knowledge of DevSecFinOps principles to embed security, compliance and cost\-governance throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Demonstrated leadership of engineering teams, with a commitment to fostering collaboration, mentorship and continuous professional growth
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills, able to partner effectively with Product, Architecture, Quantitative Research and Operations
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, with a passion for building scalable, reliable and secure systems
* Deep domain knowledge of finance and trading, particularly within the cryptocurrency sector
* Experience in fast\-paced, dynamic financial or fintech environments is highly desirable


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

 Soft Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Ownership \& Reliability – Take full responsibility for your work. Deliver high\-quality service, meet deadlines, and follow through on commitments. Anticipate and proactively address potential issues before they arise.
* Initiative \& Problem\-Solving – Approach challenges with a problem\-solving entrepreneurial mindset. Make sound, independent judgments and take the initiative to drive solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
* Operational Diligence – Respond strategically to technical and operational challenges, ensuring robust and reliable trading infrastructure while instilling confidence in the team’s processes.
* Curiosity \& Growth Mindset – Continuously seek to improve your technical skills and knowledge. Stay ahead of industry trends and take the initiative to practice and explore new technologies that excite you.
* Excellent Communication Skills with a team player mindset, collaborating within a fully remote global team.


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

**Our recruitment philosophy**
 We value self\-awareness in our recruitment process. We seek people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.
   

  

**Our offer**
* A competitive salary package, with various benefits depending on the method of engagement (employee or freelancer).
* Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
* The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence


 As an employer we are committed to build an inclusive, diverse and non\-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
   

  

 Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Principal Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data center projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in mechanical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre mechanical systems, including chilled water plant design (chillers, pumps, distribution systems), air handling and distribution (CRAH/CRAC units, ducting, containment strategies), high\-density cooling solutions (direct liquid cooling, rear\-door heat exchangers), fire suppression systems (clean agent, water\-based), and energy\-efficient HVAC design incorporating economizers and free cooling strategies
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, thermal modelling, pipe sizing, hydraulic calculations, and system balancing for mission\-critical environments
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant mechanical engineering standards including ASHRAE (90\.1, TC 9\.9\), NFPA codes, and energy efficiency metrics (PUE, DCiE)
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**Responsibilities**
* Lead mechanical systems design for data centre and mission\-critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including cooling infrastructure (air\-cooled, liquid\-cooled, hybrid systems), HVAC, fire suppression, and plumbing systems
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data centre owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement

data.jd_text:
The College of Engineering (CEN) at American University of Sharjah (AUS) invites applicants for the position of the Head of the Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering (CHBE) starting Fall 2027\. The college is seeking a visionary academic leader with the responsibilities of ensuring smooth and successful operation and sustainable development of the department.
   

  

 The candidate for the position must hold earned degrees, including a doctorate, in chemical engineering or a related field. The candidate must have demonstrated leadership in research, as evidenced by her/his outstanding publication record. In addition, a demonstrated record of excellence in teaching, and in academic and relevant professional services is required. The selected individual will have the opportunity to develop and articulate a vision and long\-range plan for the department in teaching and in research strategy that embodies the relevant areas that are vital to the department and the region. Special consideration will be given to candidates with a clear vision and achievable goals that are in line with the college’s and university’s strategic plans.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate must be a dynamic, collaborative, visionary and innovative individual with demonstrated leadership experience that can promote the continued advancement of the department. He/she is expected to have strong communication skills to effectively engage with a wide variety of constituents within and outside the university. His/her leadership style should include positive attitude, transparency, integrity, trust, fairness, promptness and collegiality. In addition to the general and wide responsibilities of the department head position, as partially outlined in the
 *Faculty Handbook* 
 , the selected applicant will be required to:
   

  

* provide effective leadership with well\-defined plans to nurture and elevate the standard of the department, accompanied with the development of short\-term and long\-term strategies in alignment with the strategic plans of the college and the university
* ensure high\-quality teaching as well as holistic development of the students, using approaches such as technology supported delivery, problem\-based learning, and other cutting\-edge trends in engineering education, in addition to leading the continuous improvement of the curriculum
* facilitate the conduct of innovative and cutting\-edge research of high\-quality and impact and promote multidisciplinary research with the optimal use of research funds and research facilities
* empower, mentor, promote, inspire and support faculty and staff to develop and sustain excellence in teaching, research and service
* foster a positive culture of innovation and entrepreneurship among faculty and students
* improve continuously teaching, research and service through benchmarking
* lead the department in achieving student recruitment goals by establishing and implementing recruitment plans for undergraduate and graduate students
* enrich the students’ experience via enhanced services, exchange visits, invited speakers, field trips, student clubs, professional certifications, competitions, conferences, etc.
* secure full\-time and internship positions and provide undergraduate research experience to the students
* participate in outreach activities, including maintaining ties and collaborations with alumni, industry, government, advisory boards, other university units and community members, and maintaining involvement in local and international professional organizations
* advertise locally and publicly the achievements and expertise of the faculty, staff and students of the department through web, newsletters and media exposure to enhance the academic reputation of the program
* collect data systematically and continuously from the department to plan and execute informed decisions
* ensure and increase diversity and equity in faculty hiring and student recruitment
* maintain and actively promote a positive, safe, transparent, fair, open, respectful, collegial working environment at the department, college and university
* interact and communicate effectively with individual faculty, staff and students (and parents) on a range of professional and personal issues
* represent the faculty and staff and convey their needs to the college’s and university’s administration.
* oversee the department’s operations including scheduling, advising, registration, lab preparations, budget allocation, compliance and risk management, etc.
* review and coordinate faculty course releases, sabbaticals and leave without pay requests
* conduct fair faculty and staff annual evaluations and provide effective feedback
* evaluate faculty and staff for promotion and/or rolling contract decisions
* lead and manage accreditation visits
* performing other duties as needed or assigned by the Dean


 Applicants should fill out an application form and upload the required documents (PDF) using the following \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cen/empapp/apply.php?p\=CHE\-DH\-26\-01");"\>link. The required documents are a cover letter and a detailed curriculum vitae (including a teaching statement, a research statement, vision and goals for the department, list of courses that can be taught or were taught, and names of at least three references who would be willing to write letters of recommendation). Positions are open until filled. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

 The Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering has approximately 200 undergraduate students, 15 graduate students, 12 full\-time faculty and 3 lab instructors. Students and faculty represent very diverse backgrounds and nationalities; approximately 90 nationalities are present on campus. The department offers a Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering, a Bachelor of Science in Chemical and Biological Engineering, and a Master of Science in Chemical Engineering.
   

  

 AUS is located in the Emirate of Sharjah (about 15 km from Dubai). AUS is an independent, not\-for\-profit, coeducational university, serving more than 5,700 students. Further information can be obtained here.
   

  

 AUS is licensed and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education's Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\. The Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering offered by the College of Engineering is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("http://www.abet.org/");"\>http://www.abet.org/.

data.jd_text:
**Competitive Salary** 




  





 Charterhouse is currently working with a leading global private capital investor that is undergoing a major step\-change in its use of AI and automation. With offices across the UK, USA, UAE and other global hubs, the firm runs a high performance, investment led environment and is now ready to bring its AI capability fully in house.
 



 As part of this transformation, we are exclusively supporting the appointment of a Head of AI \& Automation. This will be the firm’s first dedicated AI hire (Individual Contributor) and a pivotal role in shaping how the organisation will operate in the years ahead.
 



  





 The Head of AI \& Automation is a practical, high‑impact role that will take charge of the firm’s AI, automation and data efforts. The focus isn’t on building complex machine‑learning systems from scratch, but on choosing the right tools, setting them up properly and making sure they’re used effectively across the business. data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
**Who are we**
 At Balio Software we acquire and scale niche B2B software companies worldwide, bridging the gap between traditional software stability and AI innovation. Our team consists of successful SaaS founders and investors who have accelerated companies into high\-performing businesses. Today, we are driving systemic change across our portfolio by deploying an AI\-first mindset. By integrating advanced AI solutions into the companies we purchase, we elevate market value and sharpen value propositions, enabling businesses to excel as agile, efficient, and modern organisations. We are operators at our core, powered by the future of intelligence.
   

  

**The role**
 Balio is hiring a Head of Portfolio Engineering to set the technical direction for our portfolio of acquired software businesses and build the engineering function that will scale with us. This is a hands\-on leadership role that sits at group level; working across every product and team in our portfolio, you'll raise the quality bar, consolidate infrastructure, and give our engineering teams the tools and standards to build AI\-native by default. This is a fully remote role and you will work with teams across multiple time zones (AEST to PST).
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Engineering leadership across all portfolio companies, setting the technical direction, quality bar, and operating cadence.
* Hiring, developing, and holding accountable engineering leads at each portfolio company; building a bench of talent across the group.
* Driving an AI\-first engineering approach, identifying where AI tooling, automation, and agents can accelerate product delivery and reduce manual overhead.
* Partnering with portfolio company GMs to translate business goals into technical roadmaps.
* Serving as the primary escalation point for engineering risk, architecture decisions, and major technical investments across the portfolio.
* Running a lightweight shared services function where applicable \- identifying where tooling, infrastructure, or practices can be standardised across companies.
* Reporting directly to the Head of Portfolio you will serve as the technical lead within the Balio leadership team.


**Who You Are**
* A senior engineering leader \- you've run engineering teams of 15\+ people and know what good looks like across the full SDLC. Strong preference for experience managing across multiple teams.
* Broadly technically credible \- across SDLC, architecture, infrastructure, and delivery, with strong mentorship and decision\-support capability.
* Operationally sharp \- comfortable managing across multiple products/companies simultaneously, with strong prioritisation instincts.
* An AI native \- you use AI tools daily, you think about how to embed them in engineering workflows, and you hold a genuine conviction that AI changes how software gets built. The focus is practical productivity gains, not buzzword\-led initiatives.
* A strong communicator \- able to translate technical complexity for commercial stakeholders and vice versa.
* Comfortable with ambiguity \- this role is being built; the right person will shape it.


**Background we'd expect**
* 10\+ years in software engineering, with 4\+ years in an engineering leadership role (VP Eng, Head of Engineering, or equivalent).
* Experience in a multi\-product or portfolio environment preferred (PE\-backed, holding company, or venture studio).
* Track record of improving engineering velocity and quality in acquired or turnaround businesses.
* Experience shipping measurable quality or productivity gains using AI assisted workflows


 By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
 Based at our Corporate Office in Dubai, the Senior Legal Counsel is responsible to provide support and assistance in relation to all aspects of DP World \- Maritime Solutions business activities with the focus on shipping transactional work (charter\-parties, financing, sale \& purchase, new\-builds, vessel flagging, regulatory, insurance, corporate, JVs) plus disputes/litigation.
   

  

 The Senior Legal Counsel will provide high quality, targeted and accessible legal advice across a range of maritime practice areas and will work as a valued business partner with colleagues across DP World \- Maritime Solutions in order to secure and deliver effective solutions to legal issues. The Senior Legal Counsel will need to be highly experienced and technically proficient in their areas of maritime legal specialism and also act as the senior in\-house expert for a specific practice discipline e.g. arbitration, ship finance, Sale \& Purchase, vessel flagging. They will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy on complex legal matters. The Senior Legal Counsel will lead and manage their own portfolio of matters, but they will also work collegiately with rest of the legal team and Head of Legal on larger legal projects, particularly those which require input from multiple specialisms or experience. The Senior Legal Counsel will also assist in and supervise the work of the Junior Legal Counsel and Paralegals in the legal team.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* The Senior Legal Counsel will lead and manage their own portfolio of matters, with need for minimal supervision by Head of Legal
* Act as lead counsel in transactions and advise the Group in all legal issues regarding the ownership and operation of DP World \- Maritime Solutions vessels and vessel owning companies in the company Group to mitigate risk and align matters with DP World \- Maritime Solutions policy and capacity, in particular:
* Act as lead to Prepare, review and negotiate charter party contracts, vessel acquisition and disposal contracts, including related tax and insurance matters.
* Act as lead on legal material to and review tenders and bid proposals contracts, including drafting and reviewing NDA, LOI, MOU.
* Act as lead on Drafting, reviewing, and negotiating shipbuilding contracts including completion of delivery and registration formalities.
* Act as lead on Reviewing financial \& loan agreements, including assisting on loan documentation and ensure compliance with loan covenants.
* Act as lead in preparation and review of joint venture, collaboration and alliance agreements.
* Act as lead on general contracts, including IT, procurement, and labour related contracts.
* Act as lead on maritime insurance claims with nominated insurance brokers and insurance underwriters when necessary.
* Take a lead role in administering the legal framework and compliance requirements of the organization to ensure continuity of business and appropriate company corporate structure.
* Identify strategic legal requirements and initiatives from time to time, and drive these with need for minimal supervision.
* Act as lead counsel and work with Finance/Tax team to Identify tax implications for business activities and implement structures to handle required tax implications, including preparation and review of agreements between entities within the DP World \- Maritime Solutions incorporating applicable transfer pricing principles.
* Act as lead counsel and work with Finance/Tax team to optimize and oversee the corporate structure of the DP World \- Maritime Solutions Group including establishment of new companies and closure of companies where determined, including taking lead role in preparing corporate documents, loan agreements, shareholder and board documents.
* Act as lead counsel to evaluate and determine whether external legal advice is required, prepare briefing material for external providers of legal services and advise relevant internal department on such matters. Act as focal point with external lawyers and the P\&I Club on matters/disputes being handled externally.
* Act as lead in Drafting and revision of Company standard agreements and other legal documents as required.
* Act as lead in Drafting and revision of internal control routines and procedures.
* Act as lead to Coordinate and monitor litigation/other proceedings to which the Company is party or potentially party.
* Assist, advise and support the Head of Legal on ad hoc work as necessary.
* Delegate work to, work with and supervise Paralegals and Junior Counsels.
* Leading by example as a senior role model for DP World \- Maritime Solutions’ values and professional standards.
* Driving the delivery of business and corporate plans for the senior legal counsel’s own areas of responsibility.
* Driving continuous improvement within the senior legal counsel’s own areas of responsibility.
* Taking a proactive approach to risk management, ensuring risks and issues are identified, addressed and reported and, where appropriate, escalated.
* Work as lead counsel with DPW/P\&O insurance and risk management team to ensure risks are adequately addressed, understood and insured.
* Being fully aware of and actively complying with DP World \- Maritime Solutions and DPW’s policies and procedures relevant to the senior legal counsel’s own responsibilities and to corporate policies and procedure.


**Minimum Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIION \& EXPERIENCE**
* Bachelor’s degree in law
* Master’s degree in marine law or Contract law preferable


**Minimum Experience**
* 10 (TEN) years’ experience in a related field or equivalent training or experience. Must have good knowledge of contract law and
* English /common Law and shipping law
* Dependable and able to deliver contributions with little direction.


**Key Attributes**
* Excellent written, drafting and oral communication skills with fluency in English.
* Detail oriented, hands‐on, driven and able to cope with demanding deadlines.
* Focus on quality and efficiency, with positive commitment to EHSQ.
* Some disputes and compliance experience (sanctions, GDPR, anti\-bribery) will be considered a plus.
* Transaction and project management skills.


**About Us**
**ABOUT THE BUSINESS**
 P\&O Maritime Logistics (POML) is a leading provider of marine solutions with focus on offshore energy, port services and logistics. The company provides a wide portfolio of value\-added marine services and ability to integrate these offerings for its customers – always with safety and the environment at the forefront.
   

  

 Headquartered in Dubai, the company has operations globally across all seven continents.
   

  

 In July 2019, Topaz Energy and Marine was acquired by DP World, merged with P\&O Maritime and started operating under the P\&O brand as P\&O Maritime Logistics.
   

  

 www.pomaritime.com
