data.jd_text:
**Senior Project Manager – Saudi Arabia/Al\-Khobar**
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant international team.
   

  

 Siemens Digital Industries is a leading innovator in automation and digitalization. Our mission is to support customers in maximizing growth, profit opportunities and ecological footprint in the discrete and process industries. Ready to create your own journey?
   

  

 Join our Digital Industry as Senior Project Manager and help us transform the everyday by finding solutions and making the world a more inquisitive place for tomorrow.
   

  

**You‘ll make an impact by:**
* Managing customer projects end\-to\-end across the full project lifecycle, from handover through final acceptance, with responsibility for cost, schedule, quality, EHS and customer satisfaction.
* Actively steering project planning, execution, monitoring and control in line with PM@Siemens standards.
* Managing risks, opportunities, changes and claims, including identification of mitigations and commercial impacts.
* Coordinating cross\-functional and cross\-regional project teams, including engineering centers, partners and subcontractors.
* Supporting proposal, contract clarification and customer discussions by contributing project execution know\-how and solution understanding.


**Your success is grounded in**
* 10\+ years of experience in solution or automation project execution, with several years acting as fully accountable Project Manager for medium to large, cross\-organizational projects.
* Strong mastery of project management across the full lifecycle, including project planning, scheduling, cost control, forecasting, reporting, and governance according to PM@Siemens standards.
* Proven competence in risk and opportunity management, change management, claim management, and contract interpretation, including identification of commercial impacts and mitigation strategies.
* Solid understanding of industrial automation and process control solutions, including Distributed Control Systems (DCS), PLC and HMI\-based systems.
* Hands\-on project exposure to Siemens automation and digitalization products and systems such as SIMATIC PCS 7 (DCS), SIMATIC S7 (PLC), WinCC / HMI systems, and integration of industrial communication technologies.
* Familiarity with functional safety concepts and standards (e.g. IEC 61508\) as applied in automation projects.
* Strong commercial and financial project understanding, including cost controlling, cash flow, invoicing, forecasting, and collaboration with commercial project management and finance functions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage diverse stakeholders, including customers, internal engineering teams, global engineering centers, suppliers, and partners, without direct line management responsibility.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical solutions and Siemens capabilities clearly to customers.
* High level of intercultural competence and experience working in international, virtual, and cross\-regional project environments.
* Fluency in English for professional project communication; ability to operate confidently in customer meetings, reviews, and negotiations.


**Transform the everyday with us**
 We value your outstanding identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
   

  

 We celebrate the fact that our people are individuals and have different preferences and needs. If we all thought the same, we would never think of anything new! That’s why we recruit extraordinary minds from all walks of life. We are committed to furthering our culture of diversity, equity and inclusion. We encourage applications from a diverse talent pool and are happy to give the opportunity to discuss flexibility and reasonable adjustment requirements. Many of our teams are working optimally in a remote, virtual adding to our ability to offer more flexibility on how you handle your time.
   

  

 Please note: Only complete applications can be considered in the selection process.

At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. **Reimagine What’s Possible**
 Job Description and Qualifications
   

  

 Rotoflow™, an Air Products Business, is a full\-service turbomachinery OEM \- providing a wide range of new equipment solutions and services to our customers globally in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Aftermarket services such as spare parts, repairs, upgrades, field services, engineering evaluations, reliability and performance assessments, troubleshooting, training, remote diagnostics/data monitoring, and shop services are some of the many offerings provided from regional service centers for both Air Products and non\-Air Products equipment.
   

  

 We are seeking an
 **Rotoflow** 
**Aftermarket Project Manager** 
 at our turbomachinery service center in KSA\- DSC, responsible for providing projects execution with engineering support for spare parts, repairs, upgrades, reverse engineering, and field service of all types of turbomachinery.
   

  

**You Will Enjoy**
* Be part of a team to grow a world\-class service and machinery business.
* Seeing the results of candidate’s direct efforts through successful execution of customer projects.
* Being empowered to satisfy customers and have influence on changes to work processes to meet customer expectations on speed and world\-class customer service.
* Collaborating with a cross\-functional team across commercial, engineering, procurement and manufacturing on a wide variety of projects with varying technical complexity and scope.
* Significant direct interaction with customers, in coordination with account managers, ensures Rotoflow exceeds customer expectations with solutions.
* Ability to grow and develop one’s career and take on increasing responsibility.


**Responsibilities**

* Maximize revenue recognition and take necessary actions to fill the (planned vs actual) gaps.
* Ensure regular communication is provided to internal and external stakeholders and customers on the status of projects and develop relationships that will indirectly drive and boost sales.
* Lead and guide the execution team and provide directions on objective priorities to ensure tasks and deliverables are completed as planned.
* Manage changes on projects to keep projects on track and meet financial and customer targets.
* Provide feedback on lessons learned during execution to other functions to assure continuous improvement.

* Project Management Experience, \> 5 years is preferred, with excellent written and oral communication skills and demonstrated ability to effectively lead and organize engineering teams and handle multiple projects simultaneously.

* Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP is beneficial
* Detailed knowledge of rotating equipment's / turbomachinery, accessory systems, and related technologies and services is a plus.
* Goal oriented, self\-motivated, highly organized, with ability to drive success, with strong winning spirit and ability to motivate teams.
* Excellent creativity, problem solving, and decision\-making skills \- including an understanding of when to escalate both technical and administrative decisions.
* Aptitude and desire to quickly learn.
* Excellent time management skills.
* Ability and drive to continuously improve and eliminate unnecessary barriers or complexity to meeting customer needs
* Ability to create an environment of trust and consistently exhibit a positive attitude.


 We are the world’s largest hydrogen producer with over 80 years of industrial gas experience. We are hydrogen and industrial gas experts delivering safe, end\-to\-end solutions, investing in real, clean energy projects at scale, and driving the industry forward to generate a cleaner future.

data.jd_text:
We are looking for a
 **Project Manager \- Credit Card Migration to join a well\-known Islamic Bank in Bahrain.** 
 The Ideal candidate will lead and deliver end\-to\-end credit card system and/or portfolio migration initiatives, ensuring successful execution across scope, time, budget, quality, and operational readiness. Own the migration governance, planning, stakeholder coordination, execution, cutover, and post go\-live stabilization while ensuring accurate data reconciliation and business sign\-off.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\) Project Governance \& Delivery Management** 



* Define and apply an appropriate project management framework and delivery governance (steering, working groups, RAID, milestones, reporting cadence) to ensure completion within agreed scope, quality, and timelines.
* Prepare the project brief/charter and initiation documentation; establish clear scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage scope changes through structured change control; drive decisions and approvals in a timely manner.
* Manage project risks/issues and ensure mitigation plans are actively owned and executed.



**2\) Credit Card Migration Planning \& Execution** 



* Own the end\-to\-end migration approach for new Credit Card system setup and/or system/portfolio migration, including strategy, sequencing, trial conversions, and final migration execution.
* Lead the planning and execution of parallel run and cutover planning.
* Lead data reconciliation and business sign\-off activities.
* Manage migration of account, card, transaction, installment, and fee data.
* Ensure readiness for authorization, clearing, billing, settlement, and collections flows.
* Ensure migration readiness across business, operations, technology, and vendors, including runbooks, cutover checklists, and rollback considerations.



**3\) Testing \& Environment Readiness (SIT/UAT/Parallel Run)** 



* Plan and manage SIT, UAT, and Parallel Run activities end\-to\-end, including test strategy, scope, entry/exit criteria, defect triage, and governance.
* Coordinate business users for UAT execution and sign\-off.
* Drive closure of defects, gaps, and reconciliation breaks prior to go\-live.



**4\) Data Migration, Reconciliation \& Controls** 



* Lead the data migration lifecycle: strategy, mapping, extraction, transformation, loading, trial runs, and reconciliation.
* Establish reconciliation controls and sign\-off packs between old and new systems.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness for key datasets and balances; drive resolution of discrepancies.



**5\) Scheme \& Platform / Vendor Coordination** 



* Work effectively with CMS platforms (VisionPLUS) and associated vendors/partners, ensuring delivery alignment, integration readiness, and clear responsibilities (RACI).
* Ensure the migration scope covers Visa/Mastercard data and scheme\-related flows in alignment with business requirements and operational cutover needs.



**6\) Shariah\-Compliant Product Considerations (Preferred)** 



* Ensure the solution and migration approach supports Shariah\-compliant card structures, preferably Tawarruq/Murabaha\-based settlement and profit calculation rules.
* Coordinate requirements validation and sign\-offs with relevant product owners and compliance stakeholders as applicable.



**7\) Go\-Live Command Center \& Hypercare** 



* Lead the cutover and go\-live command center, including war\-room governance, tracking, and escalation management.
* Lead post go\-live hypercare, ensuring issue triage, prioritization, resolution tracking, and stabilization closure with formal acceptance.



**Required Knowledge \& Experience (Must Have)** 



* In\-depth understanding of credit card lifecycle including: issuance, authorization, billing, settlement, reconciliation, collections, disputes, and chargebacks.
* Proven experience managing and executing credit card migration projects (system migration and/or portfolio migration).
* Knowledge of CMS platforms (VisionPLUS).
* In\-depth understanding and experience on: parallel run and cutover planning; data reconciliation and sign\-off; account, card, transaction, installment, and fee data; authorization, clearing, billing, and collections flows; data migration strategy, trial conversions, and reconciliation.
* Experience working on Visa/Mastercard data.
* Hands\-on experience managing SIT, UAT, and Parallel Run.
* Experience leading cutover planning and Go Live command center.
* Proven ability to lead post GoLive hypercare and issue resolution.



**Preferred / Advantage** 



* Understanding of Shariah\-compliant card structures, preferably Tawarruq/Murabaha\-based settlement and profit calculation rules.
* Experience in setting up a new Credit Card system (greenfield implementation) in addition to migration.



**Education \& Certifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline.
* PMI certification (or equivalent) is strongly preferred.



**Core Competencies \& Skills** 



* Excellent communication and stakeholder management across business, technology, and vendors.
* Customer focus and outcome\-driven delivery mindset.
* Strong planning and organizing skills with governance discipline and structured execution.
* Problem solving, analytical thinking, and a strong reconciliation mindset.
* Accountability and ownership; ability to lead under pressure during cutover/go\-live.
* Ability to negotiate, influence, and broker alignment across multiple stakeholders.



**Key Deliverables (Examples)** 



* Project charter, integrated plan, governance calendar, RAID log, and weekly/monthly status reports.
* Migration strategy and detailed cutover runbook (including rehearsal outcomes).
* Trial conversion results and reconciliation sign\-off packs.
* SIT/UAT/Parallel Run plans, defect dashboards, and final readiness assessment.
* Go\-live command center tracker and hypercare closure report.



**Stakeholders / Interfaces** 



* Cards Business/Product, Operations (billing/settlement/collections), IT delivery teams, Data/Integration teams.
* Vendors (CMS/VisionPLUS), scheme partners (Visa/Mastercard), and internal governance (PMO/SteerCo).

We are hiring a Senior Executive Director to lead private equity investments from Bahrain, with responsibility for sourcing, executing and managing deals across the GCC and select international markets. This role is central to the platform’s growth and will work closely with senior leadership and the broader alternatives franchise.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




  




* Lead origination, thesis development and pipeline management across target sectors and geographies.
* Run end‑to‑end execution on transactions: financial modelling, valuation, due diligence, structuring and SPA negotiations.
* Prepare investment‑committee‑standard materials and present, defend and refine investment cases at committee.
* Take active post‑close ownership through board roles, performance monitoring, value creation oversight and exit execution.
* Support fundraising initiatives, LP co‑invest processes and coaching/development of junior investment professionals.



  





**What you bring** 




  




* 12–18 years’ experience, primarily in direct private equity investing, with formative training in investment banking (M\&A, leveraged finance) or transactions advisory.

* Deep GCC/MENA market knowledge and established relationships with regional advisors, banks and asset owners.
* Expert‑level financial modelling and LBO skills, with investment‑committee‑ready analytical and presentation standards.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics or a related discipline; CFA and/or MBA from a top‑tier institution preferred.



  





**Why this platform** 




  




* Join a Bahrain‑headquartered financial group with a growing alternatives and private equity platform, investing across the MENA region and key international markets.
* Operate from a modern waterfront financial district designed to host leading investment firms and provide direct access to regional capital flows.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 To drive the delivery of a risk\-based Technology Audit portfolio, providing strategic assurance and insights that strengthen IT governance, controls, and business performance. The role leads complex technology audit engagements standalone or integrated with business audits, develops high\-performing teams, fosters collaboration, and ensures the Internal Audit function adds measurable value to organizational objectives.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Technology Audit and Advisory Delivery** 




  




* Supports with the technology component of a risk\-based IA plan by coordinating and managing the delivery of the IT risk assessment and annual planning activities. This involves proposing audit engagements for inclusion in IA plans, including the scope, timing, and required resources.
* Acts as the Engagement Manager\* for multiple or large integrated audit engagements concerning technology audit areas within the IA Department. Responsible for the day\-to\-day project management of the engagements across planning, fieldwork and reporting, ensuring delivery of high\-quality assurance and advice, on time and within allocated budget.
* Establishes and maintains regular coordination between the IA Director (or Executive Director), management and the engagement team on the
* progress of engagements, ensuring corrective actions are taken to address any identified issues impacting the engagement plan.
* Regularly monitors and reports on the progress of management action plans, facilitating the effective and timely implementation of management action plans. This involves guiding action owners (where necessary), challenging revised due dates, escalating overdue actions and managing the verification of closed actions.
* Supports and coach engagement teams throughout the engagement lifecycle, to facilitate the correct application of the IA methodology, and enhances the teams’ functional and leadership competencies.
* Supports the VP, Internal, IA Director (or Executive Director) with the delivery of their role, as delegated.
* Ensure delivery of high\-impact, risk\-based audits that enhance control effectiveness and strengthen control environment and organizational governance.



  





**IT Governance Framework, ERP and Data Analytics** 



* Evaluate the design and effectiveness of IT governance frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ISO 27001, ITIL etc.), ensuring alignment with organizational policies, regulatory expectations, and risk‑management objectives.
* Assess ERP environments (SAP S/4 Hana etc.) for configuration adequacy, access controls, change‑management practices, and process integrity across key business cycles.
* Perform technology risk assessments to identify control gaps, security vulnerabilities, and compliance issues within core IT processes and enterprise applications.
* Leverage data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Python) to perform automated testing, trend analysis, anomaly detection, and continuous\-monitoring routines.
* Develop sound audit findings and recommendations that strengthen IT controls, improve system performance, and enhance data reliability, while collaborating with stakeholders across IT, finance, and operations.



  





**Leadership** 



* Plans, manages, and reviews team performance to monitor achievement of key performance indicators.
* Provides timely feedback, coaching, and development to strengthen team capabilities.
* Proposes and implements initiatives aligned with the IA strategic direction.
* Leads or supports IA strategic initiatives and advocates for positive change in work practices.
* Build a high\-performing, future\-ready IA team aligned with strategic business goals.



  





**Quality \& Operations** 



* Ensures QAIP feedback is addressed effectively to enhance engagement quality and team capability.
* Promotes adherence to quality standards across all IA activities.
* Supports continuous improvement by identifying and implementing process enhancements and best practices.
* Drive culture of continuous improvement and excellence in audit execution.



  





**Business Partnering** 



* Builds and maintains strong client relationships to stay informed and aligned with evolving business needs.
* Develops cross\-functional relationships across TAQA to enable knowledge sharing within IA and across TAQA.
* Supports Directors at portfolio\-level reporting and insights, as required.
* Strengthen IA’s role as a trusted advisor and strategic business partner.



  





**Collaboration \& IA Strategy** 



* Shares knowledge and expertise across the IA team to enhance capability and consistency.
* Collaborates with peers and other IA teams to optimize resource use and deliver quality outcomes.
* Constructively challenges peers to enhance performance
* Recognize and celebrate collaborative behavior.
* Leverages IA Operations support to minimize administrative workload and improve efficiency.
* Foster collaborative, high\-performing culture that drives collective IA team success.
* Actively support in strategic initiatives implementation ensuring quality and timely completion of assigned tasks.



  





**Policies and Procedures** 



* Undertake all audit activities in line with IA’s policies and procedures.
* Ensure performed audit work comply with the pertinent internal audit P\&Ps and Global IIA Standards.
* Ensures consistent compliance for all assigned audit activities, reinforcing the credibility and reliability of the Internal Audit Function.



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* Professional certification: Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA),



 Certified Risk and Information System Controls (CRISC)
 



 Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
 



  





**Experience** 



* 8\-10\+ years of experience in leading technology audits or advisory in related areas. 3 to 4 years of leading audit teams.

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Service Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will be at the forefront of executing service orders for the compression fleet, driving meaningful projects that enhance operational excellence and customer satisfaction. Your role will involve strategic planning and coordination, ensuring that projects are delivered within scope, time, quality, and budget, thereby contributing significantly to Siemens Energy’s mission of sustainable energy solutions. You will work in a dynamic team environment that values collaboration, innovation, and proactive communication, fostering a culture of growth and excellence.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Execute compression service orders, including parts, repairs, field service, and complete outage projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Manage customer relationships during order execution, acting as their advocate within the organization and enhancing communication across service offerings.
* Organize and lead teams, define responsibilities, develop schedules, and allocate resources to address specific project challenges effectively.
* Extend service order management to the Middle Eastern region as needed, ensuring seamless execution and delivery.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to achieve revenue, EBIT, on\-time delivery, and project delivery targets, while driving client satisfaction and supporting cash collection.
* Collaborate with finance for accurate forecasting and coordinate with global teams to align service order execution with global standards.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management, or a related field, with 4\-6 years of relevant experience in project management, preferably in the Oil \& Gas industry or with rotating equipment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership skills, with the ability to develop and implement strategic plans effectively.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience with project management and order management tools and concepts.
* Self\-driven and adaptable, with a positive attitude and the ability to solve challenges collaboratively.
* Familiarity with CRM (Salesforce) and ERP software (e.g., SAP) is highly desirable, enhancing operational efficiency.
* Excellent communication, networking, and relationship\-building skills, with strong leadership abilities to influence stakeholders and drive project success.


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs
   

  

 The job posting will remain open for applications for 14 days from the posting date.

**Role Overview** 




 The
 **Head of Sales** 
 will be responsible for building and scaling the commercial engine of a new industrial chemicals trading and distribution business in Saudi Arabia. The role owns revenue delivery, gross margin management, key account acquisition, and commercial governance (pricing and credit discipline). The incumbent will lead a dedicated sales team, institutionalize a robust sales process—including CRM integration and forecasting—and ensure the business achieves its strategic growth targets while maintaining service reliability and risk\-managed working capital.
 



  





**Strategic Objectives** 




**Execution outcomes for the growth phase:** 



* **Market Penetration:** 
 Establish a robust base of active, repeat\-ordering customers across priority industrial segments.
* **Pipeline Health:** 
 Maintain a healthy pipeline\-to\-target ratio to ensure consistent revenue growth.
* **Profitability:** 
 Achieve targeted gross margins through disciplined pricing and segment\-specific strategies.
* **Credit Governance:** 
 Ensure controlled credit growth with rigorous collection discipline and DSO management.
* **Supply Partnerships:** 
 Secure and manage strategic relationships with global manufacturers and master distributors.



  





**Industrial Segment Focus** 




**Phase I (Primary Focus)** 



* **Surface Coatings \& Performance Materials:** 
 Raw materials and specialized inputs for industrial applications.
* **Water Management \& Process Chemicals:** 
 Consumables and project supply for industrial and service contractors.
* **Construction \& Infrastructure Chemicals:** 
 Specialized additives and raw materials for large\-scale infrastructure.
* **Mining \& Mineral Processing:** 
 Selective pursuit of process chemicals and grinding media for the cement and mining industries.



  





**Phase II (Regulatory Expansion)** 



* **Food \& Nutrition Ingredients:** 
 Development of the compliance pathway for food and animal feed\-related inputs.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Revenue Delivery \& Market Penetration** 



* Own and deliver annual sales targets with a clear, segment\-wise execution plan.
* Identify and convert a prioritized list of strategic accounts into active, long\-term partners.
* Establish a repeatable sales cadence: from prospecting and technical sampling to final approval and annual agreements.



**Key Account \& Strategic Relationship Management** 



* Personally lead senior\-level engagement with procurement heads, plant managers, and R\&D/QC leadership.
* Map customer decision processes, bridging the gap between technical approval and commercial execution.
* Negotiate framework agreements and secure preferred supplier status with Tier\-1 accounts.



**Commercial Governance: Pricing \& Credit Discipline** 



* Own the pricing strategy and execute disciplined quotation management.
* Monitor profitability by customer and segment; implement corrective actions such as mix optimization or alternate sourcing.
* Partner with finance to enforce credit limits and collection rhythms, ensuring growth is cash\-responsible.



**Portfolio Strategy \& Principal Development** 



* Define and manage the portfolio across
 **stock\-and\-sell** 
 (fast movers) and
 **back\-to\-back** 
 import models.
* Identify and onboard new suppliers, negotiating commercial terms, territories, and technical support.
* Implement principal management discipline, including demand forecasting and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).



**Leadership \& Capability Building** 



* Lead and coach the sales team, setting clear territories, activity KPIs, and performance standards.
* Drive a high\-performance culture focused on activity metrics, conversion rates, and disciplined execution.



  





**Candidate Requirements** 



* **Experience:** 
 10\+ years in B2B sales and business development within industrial chemicals distribution/trading, specifically in Saudi Arabia or the GCC.
* **Track Record:** 
 Proven success in "door opening" at strategic accounts and managing the technical selling cycle (trials/approvals).
* **Leadership:** 
 Experience managing direct reports and building sales team capabilities.
* **Commercial Acumen:** 
 Strong competence in pricing, contract negotiation, and credit\-aware selling.
* **Technical Knowledge:** 
 Familiarity with industry\-standard documentation (SDS, COA) and chemical storage/logistics constraints.
* 
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or Business.
* **Languages:** 
 Fluency in English is required; Arabic is strongly preferred.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* **Revenue \& Profitability:** 
 Revenue vs. plan and contribution margin by segment.
* **Conversion Metrics:** 
 Quote\-to\-order and trial\-to\-approval conversion rates.
* **Pipeline Management:** 
 Pipeline value, stage conversion, and forecast accuracy.
* **Financial Health:** 
 DSO, overdue percentages, and collection effectiveness.
* **Supply Chain:** 
 Number of quality supply relationships onboarded and product line launch success.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 A KSA\-based industrial commercial leader who has successfully built revenue streams from the ground up. You are a
 **"player\-coach"** 
 —capable of opening doors with senior stakeholders while maintaining the discipline required for pricing, collections, and CRM rigor. You are comfortable in a lean, execution\-driven environment and possess the social intelligence to navigate complex technical and commercial landscapes.

 \- Experience implementing or optimizing CRM strategies tied to fan engagement, memberships, and retention.

 Benefits

 Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change\-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
   

  

 Today, we rock with over 180 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels and Singapore, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
   

  

 We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well\-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high\-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.
   

  

 But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
   

  

 At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
   

  

**Mission statement**
 The
 **Tech Lead** 
 plays a pivotal role in bridging
 **business objectives** 
 with
 **technical execution** 
 . This role is not purely managerial nor solely individual contributor, but a
 **hybrid position** 
 that combines
 **hands\-on engineering** 
 ,
 **architectural leadership** 
 , and
 **team enablement** 
 . A Tech Lead ensures delivery excellence by actively contributing to the codebase, guiding the team technically, and aligning execution with long\-term strategic goals.
   

  

 At Keyrock, the
 **Tech Lead** 
 is a
 **senior technical contributor** 
 who drives the
 **implementation and delivery** 
 of engineering initiatives within their Business Unit. The Tech Lead is accountable for
 **technical execution and delivery quality** 
 , ensuring that systems are built to high standards of reliability, performance, and maintainability.
   

  

 While the
 **Head of Engineering (HoE)** 
 focuses on
 **strategic alignment \-** 
 ensuring that engineering outcomes meet the broader objectives agreed with the
 **Head of Product (HoP) \-** 
 the Tech Lead operates as the
 **executional deputy** 
 , translating those strategic objectives into code, architecture, and delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Act as the technical point of accountability for the Service Market Making Business Unit.
* Balance strategic thinking with pragmatic delivery, ensuring systems are built to last while meeting immediate needs.
* Champion collaboration across teams, ensuring alignment between product, design, QA, and engineering.
* Inspire and develop engineers through mentorship, coaching, and technical guidance, fostering growth and autonomy within the team.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Drive Delivery and Alignment: Partner with the Head of Engineering to own delivery of entire work\-streams, ensuring architecture and engineering decisions align with both immediate requirements and business strategy.
* Balance Code and Leadership: Contribute directly through coding, while also focusing on architecture design, peer reviews, and cross\-functional communication.
* Mentor and Elevate Engineers: Provide structured feedback through design and code reviews, support skill development, and empower junior and mid\-level engineers to take ownership.
* Technical Leadership: Guide system design, ensure scalability and resilience, and optimise performance across applications and infrastructure.
* Maintain Standards: Uphold engineering best practices, enforce coding guidelines, and partner with QA to embed automation and validation in the delivery pipeline.
* Codebase Health: Manage technical debt, lead refactoring initiatives, and ensure long\-term maintainability and operational excellence.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to define scope, refine requirements, and plan delivery in a transparent and predictable manner.
* Risk Management: Anticipate technical risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs early, and propose mitigations to safeguard delivery timelines.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years in a Technical Leadership position guiding teams, shaping architecture, and driving delivery of complex projects
* Demonstrated expertise in architecting and maintaining high\-concurrency, low\-latency trading systems at scale
* Advanced proficiency in Rust; working knowledge of Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript) and Python is an advantage
* Deep experience with data\-intensive architectures and real\-time data pipelines
* Proven track record deploying, optimising and operating AWS environments for ultra\-low\-latency workloads
* Hands\-on experience containerising applications and managing Kubernetes clusters in production
* Familiarity with GitOps workflows to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration and deployments
* Solid command of software engineering best practices, including Agile methodologies, DevOps principles and end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines
* Knowledge of DevSecFinOps principles to embed security, compliance and cost\-governance throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Demonstrated leadership of engineering teams, with a commitment to fostering collaboration, mentorship and continuous professional growth
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills, able to partner effectively with Product, Architecture, Quantitative Research and Operations
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, with a passion for building scalable, reliable and secure systems
* Deep domain knowledge of finance and trading, particularly within the cryptocurrency sector
* Experience in fast\-paced, dynamic financial or fintech environments is highly desirable


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

 Soft Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Ownership \& Reliability – Take full responsibility for your work. Deliver high\-quality service, meet deadlines, and follow through on commitments. Anticipate and proactively address potential issues before they arise.
* Initiative \& Problem\-Solving – Approach challenges with a problem\-solving entrepreneurial mindset. Make sound, independent judgments and take the initiative to drive solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
* Operational Diligence – Respond strategically to technical and operational challenges, ensuring robust and reliable trading infrastructure while instilling confidence in the team’s processes.
* Curiosity \& Growth Mindset – Continuously seek to improve your technical skills and knowledge. Stay ahead of industry trends and take the initiative to practice and explore new technologies that excite you.
* Excellent Communication Skills with a team player mindset, collaborating within a fully remote global team.


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

**Our recruitment philosophy**
 We value self\-awareness in our recruitment process. We seek people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.
   

  

**Our offer**
* A competitive salary package, with various benefits depending on the method of engagement (employee or freelancer).
* Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
* The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence


 As an employer we are committed to build an inclusive, diverse and non\-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
   

  

 Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

 To support the Department’s strong foundation, fostering an environment of excellence, innovation and continuous enhancement to support the delivery of a high\-quality Medicine programme at RCSI Bahrain. Champion academic standards and drive the implementation and continuous improve
data.jd_text:
**Objective:** 
 To support the Department’s strong foundation, fostering an environment of excellence, innovation and continuous enhancement to support the delivery of a high\-quality Medicine programme at RCSI Bahrain. Champion academic standards and drive the implementation and continuous improvement of the curriculum, aligned with best practice and ensure the effective delivery of the undergraduate teaching programme in Obstetrics \& Gynaecology, promoting a culture of collaboration, research engagement and academic development across the School.
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Head of Department of Obstetrics \& Gynaecology
   

  

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Academic Leadership \& Governance:**
* Provide academic leadership for the Department of Obstetrics \& Gynaecology, ensuring excellence in teaching, assessment, research, and clinical integration.
* Be accountable, through established University management and governance structures, for the delivery of all academic commitments associated with the post.
* Support in the design, development, delivery, review, and continuous improvement of undergraduate and postgraduate Obstetrics \& Gynaecology curricula, modules, and assessments.
* Ensure alignment of departmental activities with national and international standards of medical education and training, including Medical Council requirements.
* Contribute to University\-wide academic planning, quality assurance, accreditation processes, and academic policy development as required.


**Teaching and Training:**
* Contribute to clinical and campus\-based teaching across junior, intermediate, and senior cycles of the medical programme.
* Effective delivery of teaching and training at relevant clinical sites, including responsibility for undergraduate learners.
* Provide academic leadership in student assessment, including examination design, standard setting, delivery, evaluation, and feedback processes.
* Support academic and clinical faculty within the department, fostering excellence in teaching and professional development.
* Ensure appropriate use of the virtual learning environment to support teaching, communication, and student engagement.


**Clinical Leadership and Integration:**
* Support in the clinical component of the post as ensuring integration between academic objectives and clinical service delivery.
* Work collaboratively with Clinical Directors and hospital partners to ensure high\-quality Obstetrics \& Gynaecology training and service provision.
* Undertake clinical duties within designated teaching hospitals, with scope and commitment defined in agreement with relevant governance structures.
* Promote best practice in patient care, teaching, and supervision within clinical settings.


**Research and Scholarly Activity:**
* Provide support in Obstetrics \& Gynaecology research for departmental research strategy, grant activity, and scholarly output.
* Supervise faculty, trainees, and students in research activities.
* Contribute to the advancement of Obstetrics \& Gynaecology knowledge through research, publication, and academic collaboration.


**Strategic Development and External Engagement:**
* Play a key role in the development and reform of medical education, training, and research, aligned with Government policy and institutional strategy.
* Collaborate across University and clinical sites, and with postgraduate bodies, regulatory authorities, and professional organisations, on international, national, and regional initiatives.
* Represent the Department and University at internal and external forums as required.


**Compliance \& Professional Responsibilities:**
* Ensure adherence to all University, national, and regulatory policies and procedures, including health, safety, and staff welfare requirements.
* Act at all times in the best interests of the Department and University, upholding professional, ethical, and academic standards.
* Undertake such other duties as may reasonably be required in support of the role and the strategic objectives of the University.


 Requirements
   

  

**PERSON SPECIFICATION ESSENTIAL:** 
  

  

 The successful candidate will be an academic with substantial leadership experience in clinical education, service delivery, and governance, and will demonstrate the following:
   

* A minimum of 10–15 years post\-internship clinical experience in Obstetrics \& Gynaecology, including leadership responsibilities.
* Fellowship and/or Doctoral Degree in Obstetrics \& Gynaecology from a recognised international awarding body.
* Board Certification in Obstetrics \& Gynaecology (mandatory).
* Demonstrated experience in academic leadership, including responsibility for programme delivery and curriculum oversight.
* Proven track record of undergraduate teaching, assessment design, curriculum development, and quality assurance in a medical education setting.
* Experience of educational innovation, including effective use of e\-learning and virtual learning environments (VLEs).
* Evidence of research leadership, including supervision of junior faculty and trainees, scholarly output, and contribution to departmental or institutionalresearch strategy.
* Strong understanding of clinical governance, academic governance, and regulatory standards applicable to medical education and Obstetrics \& Gynaecology training.
* Excellent interpersonal, leadership, and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across academic, clinical, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Demonstrated commitment to the development and reform of medical education, training, and research, aligned with national and international standards.



*Note: This role is a
 **Full Time** 
 post and Job Description may be subject to change to reflect the evolving requirements of the school and RCSI Bahrain.*

****ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:****
* Prepare audit proposals, engagement letters, deliverables (financials), Legal Department documents etc; and ensure all these are duly signed by the respective department head and updated on server.
* Maintain accurate financial records and documentation.
* Organize dispatch documents (for all documents received before 10am daily)
* Attach transmittal sheets to all deliveries
* Coordinate delivery of documents to each department or clients (schedule for Drivers)
* Record transmittal / confirmation of delivery
* Inform concerned Manager and support staff by 5PM of undelivered/ uncollected documents with reasons.
* Maintain deliveries logbook
* File engagement letters, invoices, cheque copies and receipts in client file
* Monitor client file log to track movement of files
* Ensure all files are up to date and complete
* Proper storage and arrangement of archived files
* Manage client folders on server


**Qualifications \& Skills Required**
* Bachelor's degree in business administration and accounting/finance
* 1 to 2 years of relevant experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English.
* Strong interpersonal and time\-management skills
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information


 If you are a motivated and organized individual with a passion for providing administrative support, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity at Grant Thornton Bahrain.

**About us** 




 With our roots going back over more than (50\) years, we are one of the oldest and fastest growing Saudi\-based company that offers a diversified portfolio of products and services including infrastructure solutions on D\&B and EPC basis, development and co\-investment in real estate and renewable s, and manufacturing of renewable technologies.
 



 Recently we are experiencing a rapid growth and expansion locally and regionally; accordingly, we are looking for leaders who have big ideas that can embrace our vision to meet a variety of infrastructure needs all over the MENA region with three main business segment\- infrastructure solutions, development and co\-investment in real estate and renewable s, and manufacturing of renewable technologies.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 The Business Development Director will lead strategic growth initiatives within the Oil \& Gas sector in Saudi Arabia, with a primary focus on expanding business opportunities with Saudi Aramco, Ministry of Energy and its ecosystem.
 



 The role is responsible for identifying, developing, and securing new business opportunities, managing client relationships, and driving revenue growth aligned with the company’s strategic objectives.
 



  





**Job Relations** 




 Internal – All departments
 



 External – Stakeholders / Projects Clients / Governmental Sector.
 



  





**Reporting to** 




 Group CEO
 



 Group Vice President
 



  





**Gender** 




 Male/Female
 



  





**Industry** 




 EPC / Oil \& Gas / Infrastructure
 



  





**Employment Type** 




 Full\-time
 



  





**Job Functions** 




 Business Development
 



  





**Main Duties \& Responsibilities** 
 :
 


* Develop and execute business development strategies targeting Business Development within potential clients in KSA.
* Identify new market opportunities, partnerships, and revenue streams.
* Lead market intelligence, competitor analysis, and client mapping.
* Act as the primary interface between the company and key clients.
* Represent the company in high\-level meetings, negotiations, and industry events.
* Lead the full business cycle from opportunity identification to contract award.
* Oversee pre\-qualification processes (including Aramco vendor registration \& approvals).
* Support proposal development, pricing strategies, and commercial negotiations.
* Lead the full business cycle from opportunity identification to contract award.
* Oversee pre\-qualification processes (including Aramco vendor registration \& approvals).
* Support proposal development, pricing strategies, and commercial negotiations.
* Lead and mentor the Business Development and Proposal teams.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Operations, and PMO for integrated project delivery.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related discipline) is mandatory.
* Master’s degree in Engineering Management, MBA, or Finance is highly preferred.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, RMP, P3O or equivalent is an advantage.
* Minimum 13–19 years of experience in Business Development within Oil \& Gas/EPC with 5\+ years in a senior leadership role.
* Proven experience working with or for Saudi Aramco projects, preferably aligned with Vision 2030 initiatives.
* Aramco Approval / Experience is a MUST
* Strong knowledge of Aramco procedures, standards, and procurement processes
* Strong understanding of EPC contracts and project life\-cycle
* Expertise in tendering, estimation, and contract negotiation

data.jd_text:
**Be An Essential Part Of Everyday Life**
 DHL Supply Chain is the world’s leading contract logistics provider that combines value\-added and management services with traditional fulfillment and distribution. At DHL Supply Chain we are committed to looking after tomorrow \& today with our Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) strategy.
   

  

 So what's it like to work for DHL Supply Chain? At DHL we’re proud of our international reach as it brings together people with a wide range of skills, experiences, cultures, and viewpoints. We see the diversity of our employees as a genuine strength and we’re proud of our supportive work environment where employees are given the tools and training they need to learn, grow and succeed.
   

  

 We are offering an exciting opportunity for the position of Director Business Development in Saudi. Your role will be to lead assigned sales and accounts within the Technology, Automation and Energy (TAE) Sector, with a special focus on Technology.
   

  

 What will your responsibilities be?
   

  

  

* Lead DSC Business Development \& Account Development strategy to deliver significant growth in Saudi Arabia
* Develop a pro\-active sales plan engaging with the Marketing team and participate in relevant seminars/ conferences
* Build and leverage a strong network in Saudi Arabia to drive new business and support company growth objectives.
* Lead the team that will manage RFQs in Saudi Arabia coordinating the different roles and assembling/leading a winning wolf pack
* Close collaboration and active engagement with Chief Commercial Officer EMEA and the Sector Teams as well as other DHL sister divisions to drive further growth
* Lead the implementation of the assigned sales strategies coming from EMEA, Global, Corporate
* Main focus will be in TAE Sectors (Technology, Auto\-Mobility, Engineering \& Manufacturing, Energy, Chemicals)
* Ensure that all business initiatives are compliant with local laws and regulations in Saudi Arabia, including any relevant licensing or reporting requirements.
* Stay abreast of regulatory changes, market conditions, and economic indicators that may impact business strategy.
* Provide regular reports to senior management and stakeholders detailing progress, challenges, and future action plans.
* Manage and mentor a team of business development and sales professionals, fostering a high\-performance culture.
* Provide ongoing training, coaching, and development to ensure the team remains equipped with up\-to\-date market knowledge and skills.


 What do we need from you?
   

  

  

* Proven track record in Sales and Business Development in logistics, including warehousing \& transport
* Demonstrated success in developing and executing strategies that drive revenue growth in the Saudi market or broader Gulf region.
* Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to inspire and manage high\-performing teams.
* In\-depth understanding of the local business environment, market dynamics, and regulatory framework in Saudi Arabia.
* Excellent consultative selling skills and techniques (ACCELERATE Type)
* Proven ability to manage and influence in a matrix management environment
* Strong drive, resilience, and a proven track record in sales
* Fluency in English both written and spoken on the business level


 We look forward to your application!

data.jd_text:
**This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Senior Director, Design for the Middle School Math Initiative in Saudi Arabia.**
 This senior leadership role is focused on shaping and scaling high\-impact professional learning experiences that improve mathematics teaching and student outcomes across multiple districts and school systems. You will lead the design of multi\-year learning strategies that translate research, data, and instructional goals into coherent and scalable professional development programs for educators and school leaders. The role carries significant strategic responsibility, ensuring alignment across curriculum, leadership development, facilitation practices, and assessment systems. You will oversee a team of design leaders while collaborating closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure implementation quality and system\-wide coherence. This position blends instructional expertise, systems thinking, and organizational leadership to drive measurable improvements in student achievement and mathematical identity development. It is an opportunity to influence education at scale in a mission\-driven, impact\-oriented environment.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Define and lead the strategic vision for multi\-year professional learning programs across districts, schools, and grade levels, ensuring alignment across curriculum, instruction, leadership development, and assessment systems.
* Translate research insights and organizational goals into actionable design strategies that guide multiple teams while maintaining focus on long\-term student outcomes.
* Oversee end\-to\-end design of professional learning systems, ensuring frameworks, tools, and session structures are coherent, scalable, and research\-informed.
* Establish quality standards, design protocols, and implementation benchmarks to ensure consistency across facilitators and school systems.
* Provide guidance to design leaders on complex decisions, balancing fidelity, innovation, and scalability across varied contexts.

data.jd_text:
**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
   

  

**About The Job**
 We’re looking for a Leader, Construction / Construction Project Manager to join our Ahmadi, Kuwait team. Be a part of Worley's dynamic team as we extend our management of the KERP program for another five years. With million m2 of land successfully cleared from contamination and million tons remediated, we're leading the charge in sustainable environmental restoration. Join us and contribute to this incredible journey of transforming contaminated sites into thriving ecosystems.
   

  

 When you work for us, you get the chance to join nearly 50,000 people all driven by a common purpose – delivering a more sustainable world. We’re excited about the challenges ahead. If you ask us, there’s never been a more rewarding time to work in the energy, chemical and resources sectors.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Management, control, coordination and supervision services as well as assistance for the assigned project inclusive of budget formulation, cost control and quality assurance.
* Management of support services for supervising and directing engineering, procurement and management of construction contractors appointed by the Client.
* Management of services for Oil \& Gas production activities including start\-up and initial operations assistance as well as operational personnel and systems as required by the Client.
* Reports to the Line Manager and is authorized to deputize for him during his absence with a proven track record of managing multi\-projects in general and Design \& Engineering and Construction function in particular, in the oil and gas industry
* Is responsible for developing the overall strategy for soil remediation in the assigned areas, it includes contracting strategies and management of contractors.
* Manage and coordinate multidiscipline engineering activities to ensure projects such as FEED (front end engineering design) studies and preparation, ITB (invitation to bid) check estimate preparation, LSTK (lump sum turnkey) tender package preparation are executed in a safe, efficient, cost effective and timely manner.
* Act as primary technical coordination interface with client to ensure that the client’s expectations are satisfied.
* Ensure the project conforms to the client’s approved Basis of Design and all applicable regulatory and code requirements.
* We’re looking for a Leader, Construction / Construction Project Manager to join our Ahmadi, Kuwait team. Be a part of Worley's dynamic team as we extend our management of the KERP program for another five years. With million m2 of land successfully cleared from contamination and million tons remediated, we're leading the charge in sustainable environmental restoration. Join us and contribute to this incredible journey of transforming contaminated sites into thriving ecosystems.
* When you work for us, you get the chance to join nearly 50,000 people all driven by a common purpose – delivering a more sustainable world. We’re excited about the challenges ahead. If you ask us, there’s never been a more rewarding time to work in the energy, chemical and resources sector


**What You'll Have**
**HSE Management**
* Maintains HSE focus within the team to ensure OHSE requirements included in design and procurement.


**Client Relationships**
* Maintains and builds healthy client relationships.
* Proactively resolves performance, scope and schedule issues with the Client as they arises
* Identifies, documents, communicates and meets the client’s requirements


**Scope Management**
* Compliance with WPMP (Worley Project Management Plan)
* Compliance with requirements of the contract.
* Effective change control process application.
* Achievement of claims mitigation and claims management if appropriate.


**Cost Control**
* Monitors cost aspects of the project within direct control to forecast final costs, identifies trends and takes action to avoid cost overruns.
* Promotes implementation of VIP (value improving practices) on the assigned project to achieve overall effectiveness of the use of capital on projects.


**Quality Management**
* Contributes to compliance with Worley policies and procedures.
* Strong working knowledge of Worley engineering and procurement systems and procedures.


**Team Management**
* Focuses team on achievement of milestones and other key project objectives.
* Listens to the team, discusses the issues, resolves problems and directs activities to remove roadblocks and achieve objectives.


**Design Management**
* Sets clear objectives to the design team, including achieving productivity and budget targets.
* Ensures design team aware of, and complies with, applicable regulations and codes.
* Manages inter\-discipline interfaces effectively.


**About You**
 You will have Bachelor's degree in Engineering with a remarkable year of experience.
   

  

* Remarkable year of experience.
* You are an individual who is self\-motivated, proactive, and works well with a team.
* You will be seen as the Subject matter specialist for the resolution of issues arising across all areas of the job and be able to clearly explain complex processes that surround the role.
* We expect you to ensure the integrity of the work scope and that all work is carried\-out in accordance with applicable codes and standards.
* We expect you to mentor of less experienced members of staff including ‘hands on’ approach to the formulation and delivery of training programs for local Kuwaiti personnel.


**Why you should apply**
* Providing an agile culture and challenging work opportunities results in a positive work environment. Our people enjoy competitive compensation packages and a fun, personal, collaborative and safe working environment. We value equal employment opportunity and are committed to promoting fairness, equality and diversity.
* Our policy is to conduct background checks for all candidates who accept an offer of employment with us.


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

**Mandatory requirements:**
* Proven, hands\-on retail bank merger integration experience (Day 1 readiness through post\-merger stabilisation)
* Experience operating or establishing an Integration Management Office (IMO)
* English Fluency (\& Arabic Preferred)
* Immediately Available


**Purpose of Project:**
 As part of the retail bank merger, this role is responsible for owning and managing all technology and technical product elements of the integration programme. The Technical Product Manager bridges the gap between business integration objectives and technical execution — defining the technology roadmap, managing system integration work streams, and ensuring seamless delivery of core banking, digital, and data migration components across the merging entities.
   

  

**Key Activities:**
* Own the technology integration roadmap from discovery through to live cutover and post\-migration stabilisation
* Lead API mapping, system architecture design, and integration specifications across all platforms
* Manage core banking system integration, digital channel consolidation, data migration, and infrastructure cutover
* Coordinate with engineering teams, technology vendors, and business work stream leads to align technical deliverables to programme milestones
* Define and maintain integration playbooks, API specifications, technical run books, and cutover plans \[jobs.dcg.co]
* Monitor system performance (latency, reliability, transaction integrity) during and post\-integration


**Core Responsibilities:**
* Technology Strategy \& Roadmap Ownership — Define, own, and execute the technology integration strategy and product roadmap, aligning to the merger's business objectives, regulatory requirements, and IT architecture standards. Prioritise technology workstreams to maximise integration velocity and minimise customer disruption.
* Core Banking \& System Integration — Lead the integration of core banking platforms, digital channels, payment systems, and data infrastructure across the two merging entities. Manage vendor relationships with core banking providers, ensuring timely certifications and technical sign\-off at each integration milestone.
* Product Lifecycle Management (SDLC) — Drive end\-to\-end product delivery using Agile and SDLC best practices — from requirements gathering and technical design, through development, UAT, and live deployment. Maintain integration backlogs, sprint plans, and release schedules in tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Technical Communication — Act as the primary liaison between senior business stakeholders, engineering teams, IT vendors, and Compliance/Legal. Translate complex technical dependencies into business\-friendly language for SteerCo and executive audiences.
* Data Migration \& Quality Assurance — Oversee end\-to\-end data migration strategy, including data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, and post migration validation. Ensure data integrity and regulatory compliance (GDPR, local data residency laws) throughout.
* Risk, Performance \& Continuous Improvement — Identify, assess, and mitigate technology risks (integration failures, system downtime, data loss). Monitor live integration performance metrics and iterate rapidly to resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and SLA adherence post\-cutover.


**KPIs**
* % of technology milestones delivered on schedule and within budget
* System uptime and availability during cutover windows (target: 99\.9%\+)
* Data migration accuracy rate (target: 100% reconciled with zero data loss)
* Number of integration defects / severity\-1 incidents post\-cutover
* API integration delivery timelines vs. plan
* Time to complete core banking system cutover vs. target
* Business stakeholder satisfaction with technical delivery (SteerCo rating)


**Knowledge And Experience**
* 8\+ years of product management or technology delivery experience in fintech, banking, or financial services
* 3\+ years leading integrations with banks, payment processors, or core financial systems \[tealhq.com]
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of core banking platforms (e.g., Temenos T24, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Finacle, Mambu, Fiserv, Jack Henry)
* Expertise in payment rails: SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, RTP, and local real\-time payment schemes
* Experience with data architecture, pipelines, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and DevOps practices \[jobs.anitab.org]
* Experience working in regulated banking environments — familiar with regulatory technology requirements and compliance obligations during system transitions


**Mandatory Skills\*\***
* Proven experience managing technology integration workstreams in a banking M\&A or large\-scale transformation context
* Hands\-on technical fluency with core banking platforms, APIs, and system architecture
* Track record of end\-to\-end product lifecycle management in regulated financial environments
* Familiarity with payment rails (SWIFT, ACH, local real\-time payment schemes), data migration, and digital channel consolidation
* Agile/SAFe certified (PMI\-ACP or equivalent); TOGAF or ITIL

**Position Overview**




 We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Lighting Sales Manager with a strong background in managing medium and large\-scale lighting projects across Kuwait. The ideal candidate will have well\-established relationships with engineering consultants, main contractors, and end clients, and will be capable of leading a sales team while personally driving key account development. You will take ownership of the full project sales cycle — from early specification influence through to order closure and delivery coordination.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Sales Leadership \& Strategy** 



* Develop and execute a structured sales strategy for lighting projects aligned with the company's annual revenue targets and growth objectives.
* Lead, mentor, and manage the lighting sales team, setting individual targets and conducting regular performance reviews.
* Report weekly and monthly project pipeline status and sales performance directly to the Managing Director.



**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with key engineering consultants, MEP contractors, main contractors, interior designers, and project owners across Kuwait.
* Conduct regular client visits, site surveys, and design\-stage meetings to influence lighting specifications in favour of the company's portfolio.
* Act as a senior point of contact for key accounts, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and repeat business.



**Technical \& Commercial Sales** 



* Prepare and present detailed technical proposals, lighting design concepts, and commercial quotations tailored to project requirements and budgets.
* Review tender documents, BOQs, and consultant specifications to ensure correct product selection and full compliance.
* Negotiate pricing, contract terms, and supply agreements with clients, contractors, and manufacturers to close orders profitably.
* Collaborate with manufacturer representatives and technical teams to deliver customised lighting solutions, mock\-ups, and value\-engineering alternatives.



**Project Execution \& Coordination** 



* Oversee order handling, delivery scheduling, and documentation (product data sheets, photometric reports, warranties, and certifications) to ensure on\-time project delivery.
* Monitor active projects to ensure alignment with client timelines, budget constraints, and technical specifications.
* Resolve post\-sale technical issues and coordinate with suppliers to manage warranties, replacements, and site support.



**Market Intelligence \& Business Development** 



* Identify and pursue new project opportunities in commercial, hospitality, retail, government, healthcare, and infrastructure segments across Kuwait.
* Conduct ongoing market research to track competitor activity, new project awards, and emerging lighting technology trends.
* Evaluate and expand the company's lighting product portfolio in response to market demand and project requirements.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements**



* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline (preferred).
* Minimum 8 years of lighting project sales experience in Kuwait, with a demonstrated track record of managing medium and large\-scale projects from specification to delivery.
* Strong existing network of relationships with engineering consultants, MEP contractors, and procurement decision\-makers in the Kuwait market.
* Proficiency in lighting design and calculation software (DIALux, Relux, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.
* Solid commercial acumen with experience in tender preparation, BOQ analysis, and contract negotiation.
* Prior experience in a managerial or team\-lead sales capacity.
* Bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English
* Valid Kuwait driving licence; must be based in Kuwait with a transferable residency visa.

**About the Role** 









 The
 **Service Operations Manager**

 This position plays a critical role in managing service delivery through internal teams and Authorized Service Providers (ASPs), optimizing resources, and strengthening operational processes. The role also supports business growth by closely aligning with service sales, enhancing customer relationships, and ensuring compliance with company standards, local regulations, and ISO management systems.
 



  





**How You Will Make an Impact** 




  




* Report directly to the Service Director and take full responsibility for Service Operations across Oman.
* Drive revenue growth and profitability by ensuring operational excellence, cost control, and efficient execution of service activities.
* Lead, develop, and coach the operations team to achieve business targets, including revenue, margin, collections, and cost management.
* Conduct regular operational reviews, including bids, quotations, contracts, and estimates to ensure accuracy and competitiveness.
* Establish and enforce operational discipline through standardized tools, processes, and performance management.
* Act as a key member of the DAOM leadership team, providing regular performance updates and strategic inputs.
* Monitor, analyze, and improve the performance of operations teams, ASPs, contractors, and third\-party manpower.
* Ensure timely execution and invoicing of service jobs to meet monthly revenue recognition targets.
* Drive key service KPIs such as response time, first\-time fix rate, and customer satisfaction.
* Support service sales by generating leads for AMC, OMC, T\&M, spare parts, and replacement opportunities.
* Plan and manage operational budgets, manpower, and resources to support current operations and future growth.
* Develop and strengthen the ASP network, ensuring proper contracts, performance tracking, and payment structures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, contractors, dealers, and service partners.
* Handle and resolve escalated service issues, ensuring timely closure and high customer satisfaction.
* Communicate regularly with DAOM management and regional teams on service performance, profitability, and improvements.
* Oversee performance management and development of the service operations team.
* Monitor job progress and ensure timely closure of pending service activities.
* Coordinate closely with spare parts teams to ensure availability of materials and minimize service delays.
* Oversee spare parts operations, including planning and inventory management for internal and external customers.
* Ensure full compliance with local regulations, company policies, and ethical standards.
* Drive implementation and maintenance of ISO standards (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001\) within the department.
* Lead recruitment, development, and retention of operational staff.
* Ensure full compliance with EHS requirements for employees, ASPs, and subcontractors.








**What You Need to Succeed** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical / Electrical or equivalent).
* Minimum 10 years of experience in HVAC service operations, with at least 3 \- 5 years in a managerial role.
* Proven track record of successfully managing HVAC service operations within Oman or GCC markets.
* Strong technical expertise in VRV/DX systems, chillers, controls, and airside products.
* Extensive experience managing technicians, engineers, contractors, and service providers.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including contracts, pricing, margins, and cash flow management.
* Experience in spare parts operations, inventory planning, and service logistics.
* Familiarity with ISO standards (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001\) and operational best practices.
* Strong leadership, team management, and coaching capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to drive performance improvements.
* Customer\-focused with a strong commitment to service excellence.
* Proficiency in English (written and spoken); Arabic is an advantage.
* Experience in multinational HVAC organizations.
